1520: Veitachadat (nusach acher vaatachedat) kinureha. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:13) veshava el bet aviha kinureha, kegon (Iyov 33:25) veyashuv lime alumav. kegavvna deilana dekatztzitztzu leh, veitchaddash besharshoy. vehay ihu raza, deman demit bela zera.

Veod it raza achara, dilvatar yete begilgula, veyitchaddesh kemillekaddemin. vehayeynu almana ugerusha, deitterachat miginta deeden, uvegin da itkeriat gerusha, kegon (Bereshit 3:24) vaygaresh et haadam. uman garim lah. begin dezra en lah, demit belo benin. veshava el bet aviha kinureha, detavat behay alma behahu naar ben yavam, vehayeynu veshava el bet aviha kinureha. ulevatar dezakkat lezra millechem aviha tochel. vechol zar la ychal bo vegomer. (Devarim 25:5) lo tihye eshet hammet hachutztza, leish zar.

Amar raya mehemna, hilel veshammay, deatun, chad missitra derachame, vechad missitra dedina, deinnun chesed ugevura, dargin deavraham veyitztzechak. veattun miggizayyhu, itkenashu hacha, attun utemanin talmidim dahavo leh lehillel. veof hachi talmide bet shammay, lisudata demalka.

Ha okimtun, attun vechavrayyay deimmechon, mare dehoraot, deokimtun, en habbotztzea rashay lemechal, ad sheyaanu amen mare seudata, velet mare seudata rashshain lemechal, ad shechal habbotztzea. vadday kad batztza baal habbayit, uvatztza leinnun mare seudata, lav lechullehu meshaer shiura chada, delav orach illen botztzein, livtztzoa beshav, dilzimnin yahiv leda kavetztza, uleda kazayit. vechad onin amen al hay betztzia, kodem deyichul baal habbayit, mechabberin teren shiurin kachada, bechazzayit vechabbetztza, yeahdonahy, amen, da lav ihu al haachila, ella al habbetztzia, levatar deinnun shiurin mitztzetarfin beamen, yichul baal habbayit. vehayeynu (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) ariti mori im besami achalti yari im divshi, ulevatar ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim. ichlu reim, mare seudata. dihon benin bediyyukena deavuhon.

Ha hacha lechem bishte kikkarot, veshiuro kazzayit vechabbetztza. may nihu lechem happanim defatora demalka. ella ha okmuha, deit leh teresar anpin. umay nihu. ella innun 4 anpe aryi. 4 anpe shor. 4 anpe nesher. veinnun (Bamidbar 6) yevarechcha yedod. yaer yedod. yissa yedod.

Umenalan delechem happanim ihu mippatora demalka. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 41:22) vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne yedod. 12: 12 anpin. veof hachi, man deit leh, bae letakkena ulesaddera al patoreh, arba kikkarot bechol seudata deshabbat, litlat seudate teresar anpin.

Vei tema lav innun ella shit middeorayyta, mishshum lechem mishne. ella la nechul lemidkar 6, bela chavreh, 6 6, shit milella letatta, veshit milletatta leella. lokovel shit dargin dechurseyay illaa. veshit dargin dechurseyay tattaa. shit beitkasyay. veshit beitgalyay. (Devarim 29:28) hannistarot laydod elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu ad olam.

Velachme toda innun 40 challot, 10 rekikin. 10 revuchin. 10 (korach 179 amud alef) shel chametz. 10 shel matztza. ha innun 40. lokovel 10 min Adonai. 4 anpe adam. 10 min Adonai, 4 anpe arye. 10 min Adonai, 4 anpe shor. 10 min Adonai, 4 anpe nesher. hay ihu tikkuna kadmaa defatora demalka, deinnun 10 devarim detztzarich bar nash leanhaga befatora deshabbat.

Chad, letakkena patora keman deachil kamme malka. hada hu dichtiv ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai. tinyayna, netilat yadayim, ad shiura degazru rabbanan, deinnun chamesh kishrin, divhon yad pirkin. veof hachi yad pirkin innun, deyad semala. veinnun koach pirkin. lokovlayyhu koach Adonai, deinnun koach atvavn dikra kadmaa deovada divreshit. deittemar behon, (Bamidbar 14:17) veatta yigdal na koach yedod.

Veeser etztzeban, remizi leeser amiran deovada divreshit. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, man dimzalzel bintilat yadayim, neekar min haolam. amay. begin deit behon raza deeser amiran, 34 atvavn, divhon itbere alma.

Telitaa, kos divracha, detakinu beh asra devarim. haddacha. shetifa. itur. ituf. chay. male. mekabbelo bishte yadav. venotno bayyamin. venoten enav bo. umagbiho min hakkarka tefach. umeshaggero bemattana leanshe beto.

Veorach raza, kos (Devarim 33:23) male birkat Adonai. kos 15 elohim. umittamman nishmeta, deihi al shemeh kos. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 116:13) kos yeshuot essa. man yeshuot. Adonai etztzeban. deinnun lokovel Adonai sefiran dechos. deihu elohim chayyim bina
1521: Mitpashsheta behon, lechamshin tarin. Adonai zimnin eser. beat 10, deihu 10 devarim detakinu rabbanan bechos, deihu elohim chayyim, Adonai atvavn, bechushban Adonai.

Veukemuha bechos, shetztzarich haddacha ushetifa. haddacha mibbachutz, ushetifa mibbifnim. veraza demilla, sheyyehe tocho kevaro. man dezache lenishmeta mehay kos, lemehevi nishmeta dachya millego umillevar. veraza demilla, (Vayikra 16:19) vetiharo vekiddesho, tohora mibbifnim, ukedusha mibbachutz. uma kos lav taharateh ukedushateh millego umillevar bela mayya. uf hachi nishmeta, lav taharatah ukedushshatah millego umillevar bela orayyta. uvegin da amar rabban gamliel, mi sheen tocho kevaro lo yikkanes levet hammidrash. begin delav ihu missitra deilana dechayyi, ella meetz haddaat tov vara.

Itur, okmuha meatro battalmidim. veorach raza, Adonai ihu kos, meatro battalmidim beat 10, deihu ateret al Adonai. ituf, tzarich leatafa resheh begin dishchinta al resheh. dehachi ukemuha mare matnitin, asur letalmid chacham lemehach 4 ammot begiluy harosh. mishshum (Yeshayahu 6:3) melo chol haaretz kevodo. kol shekken bivracha, uveadkerat shema kadisha, lemehevi begiluy harosh.

Deat 10 min yedod, ihi itatef baor, veitavid avvir. (vehayeynu avira deeretz yisrael machkim) begin deat 10 deihi chachma baavir, vehayeynu or deitataf beh kad bara alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:2) ote or kassalma. vehay ihu (Bereshit 1:3) yehi or yehi avvir. veokmuha mare sitre tora, beterem nithavav kol davar, nithavu hahavayot. uvegin da yehi or vayhi or, dehava mikkadmat dena.

Chay ukemuha, chay min hechavit. veorach raza, shechinta illaa ihi teminaa disfiran mittatta leella, uvegin da itkeriat 8, veittemar bah (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yibbane bayit. vehayeynu chavit: 8 bayit. uvegin deihi chayyim, dichtiv (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah, yayin mittamman ihu chay. veda ihu yina deorayyta. man deishtedal bah, ikre chay. veod, tzadik chay. ihu chay min hechavit.
Yayin it minneh teren gavvnin, chivvavr vesumak. yayin, 70 anpin. ha amud bet. velokovel teren gavvnin deyayin, ihi zachor veshamor deshabbat, ve tevin dekidush vaychullu, ha amud bet.

Malle, hada hu dichtiv kos (Devarim 33:23) male birkat Adonai. veof deihu malle miyena deorayyta. bar nash hachi tzarich lemehevi shelim, kema deat amer (Bereshit 25:27) ish tam: gevar shelim. kemo (Bereshit 33:18) vayyavo yaakov shalem, hachi tzarich lemehevi nishmeta shelemata, vela yihye bah pegam, (Vayikra 21:18) dechol asher bo mum lo yikrav. uf hachi illem im yah, hu elohim, kechusheban kos. (sham 15) ihu male, vahafoch illem vetimtztza malle. ematay. kad it tamman yah. vehayeynu (Shemot 17:16) ki yad al kes yah. adonay chushebaneh 11. ammuda deemtztzaita malle min (tikkunim 70 amud alef) tarvavyyhu. uvegin da sharya aleh adam, dehu shema meforash.

Mekabbelo bishte yadav, kegavvna deorayyta, dehava bitren luchin, Adonai divran belucha chada, lokovel Adonai etztzebaan deyad yemina. vaAdonai belucha tinyayna, lokovel Adonai etztzeban deyad semala. veityeyhivu bimina dehayynu beyad yamin. uvegin da, shene luchot avanim horid beyado, vela beyadav. vehay ihu deashid kera, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo.

Venoten enav bo, begin dehay kos, deihu lokovel ara deyisrael, deittemar bah, (Devarim 11:12) tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah. veayynin dilella, innun shivin sanhedrin, umoshe veaharon alayyhu. teren ayynin illain. chad ayin yamin, vechad ayin semala, veinnun amud bet, keminyan bayyayin. vehay ihu raza denoten bakkos eno.

Umagbiho min hakkarka tefach, begin deat Adonai ihi kos, bae lesalleka lah beat 10, deihi tefach, deveh itpattechat Adonai baAdonai etztzeban. umeshaggero leanshe beto bemattana, begin deyitberach devithu, deihi nefesh, deittemar bah (Bamidbar 11:6) nafshenu yevesha en kol, veitbarchat veitavidat perin, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:11) tadshe haaretz deshe.

Reviaa, lemehevi al patoreh divre tora, dela yitkayyem beh kegavvna deamme haaretz, deittemar alayyhu (Yeshayahu 28:8) ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa. aval besitre tora okmuha, harotztze lehaashir yatztzepin, yitten shulchan latztzafon, hare shulchan lismala, deihu din, bae lekashshera beh yemina, deihu orayyta, deityehivat mechesed, deihu rachame, yemin Adonai.

Chamishshaa, okmuha mare matnitin, detztzarich lehaarich al patoreh, begin aniyyim. veraza demilla, begin ditztzedaka yaaricha yomoy, dela yitkatztzerun. kegavvna deorayyta ihu arichut yomin, bitren almin, bealma den uvealma deate lenishmeta. uf hachi tzedaka, ihi arichut yomin legufa, bitren almin, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyeycha veorech yamecha. ki hu chayyeycha baolam hazze veorech yamecha baolam habba. dealma deate legufa
1522: Litchiyyayt hammetim, dilvatar deyikum la yamut. uchegavvna dealma deate yehe kayyaym, hachi alma den yehe kayyaym.

Shetitaa, shello yehe gargeran uvalan al patoreh demalka, kegavvna deesav deamar (Bereshit 25) haleiteni, orach haleata, ella beorach techina. uf hachi, man deappik millin ditztzelotin o deorayyta mippumoy, bae leappaka lon behatechana shelemim, vela behaleata chaserim. velo od, ella begin sakkana deshema yakdim kane lavveshet.

Sheviaa, mayim acharonim. veokmuha, mayim rishonim mitztzeva. veacharonim chova. veemtztzaiyyim reshut. mayim rishonim tzarich lesalleka etztzeban, begin dela yehadrun mashkin vitammeu et hayyadayim. veit merabbanan deamre, deacharonim mishshum melach sedomit, shello tesamme et haenayim. vei hachi appekin lon mechova. vesatre milin, illen deamru alayyhu chova, velav orach ara lesatra geonim millin, (sefer acher meillen deamre alayyhu) ella deitkere alayyhu, (Devarim 17:11) al pi hattora asher yorucha.

Velo od, ella deamru alayyhu 3 kedushshot, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. vehitkaddishtem ellu mayim rishonim. vihyitem kedoshim ellu mayim acharonim. ki kadosh, ze shemen arev. ani Adonai, zo beracha. veemtztzaiyyim, ben gevina levashor. uvegin da, vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai. zakkain amma, demarehon yeshavvi lon legabbeh.

Uf hachi vehitkaddishtem, beshaat tashmish. mayim rishonim dezara bar nash, mitztzeva. acharonim denukeba, chova. veemtztzaiyyim ka ramiz, vechaggevina takpieni. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 10:10) halo chechalav tatticheni vechaggevina takpieni. vehay ihu deka ramiz, ben gevina levashor, deittemar beh (Iyov 10:11) or uvasar talbisheni.

Teminaa, lishlosha tzarich kos. amay. bina ihi telitaa meeser sefiran, meella letatta. uvegin da pachut mishshelosha la tzarich kos. (davar acher) lishlosha tzarich kos, ka ramiz kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. velo od, ella deorayyta la nachta pachut mig, kohanim, leviyyim, yisreelim. tora, neviim, uchetuvim. beyrach telitay, beyom telitay. veda bina, yedu. uveginah ittemar, shalosh mishmarot havi hallayla. malchut Adonai reviit, alah ittemar arbaa mishmarot havi hallayla. vesh ditlat anfin lokovel telat mishmarot. v dearba anfin, lokovel arbaa mishmarot.

Teshiaa, kos shel beracha, reviit log, veshiura dileh, lokovel Adonai, reviaa deshem Adonai. asiraa, beasara omer nevarech lelohenu. ushechinta tattaa, ihi reviit, vaasirit. reviit leshem yedod. asirit leeser sefirin. deinnun yod hei vav hei. vechamma tzarich bar nash lenatra garmeh, dela lizrok millin illen baatar dela itztzetrich. kemo man dezarik nahama. kol shekken man dezarik nahama deorayyta, levar mippatoreh, deihi shechinta. deittemar bah, (Yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Uvechibbura kadmaa, telat innun degarmin bish legarmayyhu. teren behay alma, vechad bealma achara, veillen innun: man delayit garmeh, detanenan chad memana itpekad kammeh debar nash, uveshaata delayit garmeh hahu bar nash, hay memana, veshivin acharanin dimmanan techoteh, natlin hahi milla, veamre amen, vesalke lah leella, vedayynin lah, veihu radif abbatreh, ad deavid leh, veashlim leh hahu milla.

Man lach rav mimmoshe, deamar (Shemot 32:32) veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta, veamar letzorech, veaf al gav dekudesha berich hu avid reuteh, im kol da la ishteziv meonsha, veha ittemar dela idkar befarashat veatta tetzavvi, veitmeche mittamman. veha okmuha. man lan rav middavid malka, deamar (Tehillim 39:2) amarti eshmera darche mechato vilshoni eshmera lefi machsom beod rasha lenegdi, may beod rasha lenegdi. hahu memana deitpekad al da, venatil hahi milla leavasha leh lebar nash.

Vechad man dezarik nahama, o pirurin denahama beara, veka avid beh zilzula, kema deittemar. hane tere behay alma. vechad behahu alma, man deokid sheraga bemotzae shabbat, ad la matu yisrael likdushsha desidra, begin deka mechallel shabbeta, vegarim lenura degehinnam leittokda, ad la mata
1523: Chad ducheta it begehinnam, leinnun deka mechalle shabbeta. kevan deihu okid sheraga ad la mata zimneh, chad memana it begehinnam bemotzae shabbat, veokid bekadmita lehahu ducheta, veamar hay ducheta diflanya. vechol chayyayvin degehinnam, mesayyeye leokda hahu ducheta. hahu memana kare veamar, (Yeshayahu 22:17) hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver veotcha ato. chayyayvin degehinnam amre, (Yeshayahu 22:18) kadur el eretz rachavat yadayim shamma tamut vegomer. begin deihu garim lon leittokda, ad la mata zimnayyhu. ha lan telata, degarme bish legarmayyhu, kema deittemar.

<small>Amar raya mehemana duchetin vechulei ad al atvavn (nidpas besefer Vayikra daf 16 amud bet)</small> davar acher (Bereshit 28:12) vayachalom vehinne sullam, raya mehemana, ma 30 istallak al kol atvavn, hachi at atid leistalleka al kol biryayn. begin deistellak lishma deyod he vav he. deveh 30, dechushebaneh 30. divkadmeta havit beshem yod hei vav hei, deihu yaaa, beyg mechilan derachame, deinnun echad. kean tistelak beel, deihu 31. ditren shemahan sahadin, halo el echad beraanu. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 2:10) halo av echad lechullanu halo el echad beraanu.

Uveg yodin illen, yitkeyyaym bach, (Yeshayahu 52:13) yarum venissa vegava meod, bema. dehachi salik meod, lechushban adam. uvehippuch atvavn, meod hu adam. yarum: bearba anpin dearye, deinnun (Bamidbar 6) yevarechcha Adonai. venissa: bearba anpin deshor, deinnun yissa Adonai bismala. vegava meod: yaer Adonai, beemtzaita. veda yod he vav he, yissa Adonai panav elecha veyasem lecha shalom. reviaa Adonai, vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem.

Missitra dimina, itkeriat even. vechamma avanin mefullamin yakkirin ishtechachu minah, deminnayyhu mayya deorayyta nafkin. uveginehon ittemar, amar ribbi akiva letalmidav keshettagiu leavne shayish tahor al tomru mayim mayim shemma tistakkenu benafshechem. la temrun deinnun mayim, mayim mammash. mishshum (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay. deillen mayim, da orayyta, deittemar bah (Mishlei 6:23) vetora or. uvegin dehay nehora nevia bemabbua demayya, (Yeshayahu 58:11) asher lo yechazzevu memav, itkere mayim.

Umissitra dismala, hay even deihi 10, itkere gachelet. umittamman eser sefiran keshalhevet keshura bagachelet. veit lah 4 gavvnin, (vaasara) innun, yod he vav he. Adonai. veihi yad haggedola bimina, yad hachazaka bismala, amuda deemtzaita, mittamman ihi yad rama, kalil mimv gavvnin.

Uvegin deihi missitra dimina even, umissitra dismala gachelet, bah natil kudesha berich hu nukema, miyishmael veedom, deinnun ishshin nucherain, umayim hazzedonim. umemanan dilhon samael venachash. samael eshsha degehinnam, memune al uma deesav. nachash memune al uma deyishmael, veihu rahav dimmana al mayya.

Bimina deavraham, dedargeh chesed, natil nukema miyyishmael, umemana dileh. uvismala deyitzchak, dedargeh pachad, natil nukema meesav, umemana dileh. bitren meshichin, deinnun chad mimina, mashiach ben david. vechad missemala, mashiach ben yosef. uvedarga deyaakov, deihi lokovleh, beraza (Bereshit 48) desikkel et yadav (ki menashshe habbechor). arye lismala. shor limina, deyishmael. begin dihuda gala beesav, ishtechach yemina dikdushsha, im semala deesav. usemala dikdushsha im yemina misava deyishmael, (Bereshit 49:10) ad ki yavo shilo, raya mehemana, bedargeh tiferet yisrael, natil nukema meerev rav.

Bitlat dargin illen, yifkod (nusach acher yifkun) kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim, min galuta. uvehon natil nukema, meesav veyishmael veerev rav. kegavvna deerev rav meuravin beesav veyishmael, hachi yaakov meurav beavraham veyitzchak, eruv detarvavyyhu. vehachi mitarev shilo, im mashiach ben david umashiach ben yosef, vihe shalshelet detarvavyyhu, kehahu zimna dechaza bilam bannevua dileh, dehachi mitkashshere teren meshichin beraayya mehemana, bitlat avahan, begaluta batraa.

Patach veamar, (Bamidbar 23:21) lo hibbit avn beyaakov velo raa amal beyisrael Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo. vecholla lekayyeyma kera, (Yeshayahu 54:7) uverachamim gedolim akabbetzech. behahu zimna metavrin kelippot, dahavo mesacharin lishchinta. miyyad itgalyay avna chada mittelat avanin, deinnun segolta. dealayyhu ittemar, (Yechezkel 1:1) vayhi bishloshim shana, veinnun yAdonai barvii, avna reviaa.
1524: Bachamishsha lachodesh, avna chamishshaa. lokovlayyhu, (Shmuel 1 17:40) vayyikkach david chamishsha challuke avanim min hannachal. veinnun lokovlayyhu chamesh tevin, deinnun shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai.

(Yechezkel 1:1) vaani betoch haggola, da shechinta, bah kudesha berich hu echad. 6 betosefet vaani, hu nahar, tzadik chay almin. (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, may eden. da bina, nahar denafik minnah, da 6, ben yah, darga deraya mehemana, veraya mehemna, nafik meimma illaa, veitpashshat beshit sefiran ad tzaddik, uminneh ashke leginta (deeden), deihi shechinta.

May kevar. 20, keter. 2, bina. Rabbi, reshit chachma. keter bimina, chachma bismala, bina beemtzaita. rechev leella leillat haillot. 10 sefiran kullehu, itkalalu benahar, deihu itpeshat ad tzaddik, deihu kol, kalil kolla. uvegineh okmuha, (Daniel 4:9) ilana rabba vetakkif, umazon lecholla beh. minneh talya kolla. kad chama shechinta miggo kelifin, chaza immah eser sefiran. (ad kan raya mehemana) (ayyen 226 amud bet)
(Sefer acher uvechibbura kadmaa) solet lemincha, lealaa lehay solet, kamme malka illaa lemincha. ben teren deroin.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa, amar raya mehemana, mehay ishtemoda, hane millin setimin innun, vetzarich lemiftach lon kamme chavrayyay, avraham yitzchak detakinu shacharit umincha, ittemar alayyhu, (Yeshayahu 48:13) af yadi yasda eretz, da yitzchak. vimini tippecha shamayim, da avraham. dedargin dilhon chesed vafachad. deittemar alayyhu (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino, uvizroa uzzo, innun teren deroin demalka, deihu Adonai, ammuda deemtzaita. solet dileh, da shechinta tattaa, nehora dileh, solet nekiyyay missitroy bela pegimu dachashocha, uvela taarovet chashocha kelal. dehachi innun chashochin im nehorin, kevar kodam motz veteven.

Uvechovehon deyisrael, mitarvin chashochin binhorin, uchegavvna dedash bar nash tevua, ulevatar ihu borer lah, kevorer ochel mittoch pesolet. kach yisrael, tzarich lemebad beruchehon, kad itarav behon chashochin. veraza demilla, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara vegomer. divhachi itbar chashocha, deihu yetzer hara, dimchasse al rucha, kemotz dimchasse al chitta. o keanan, dimchasse al shimsha, vela manach leh leanhara.

Uvezimnin dechoshech, deihu yetzer hara, mechasse al yetzer hattov, deihu or. ihu keman detafis bevet haasurin deyetzer hara. veof hachi, kad yetzer hattov ihu tafis birshu deyetzer hara, hachi innun tefisin chayyaylin deyetzer hattov, birshu dechayyaylin deyetzer hara. uvezimna deyitbar bar nash rucheh, bechol evarin dileh, kodam Adonai, ma ketiv. (Yeshayahu 49:9) lemor laasurim tzeu velaasher bachoshech higgalu.

Aval shechinta ihi solet nekiyyay, delet chashocha vekabbala yachil leitarva bah. ihi kagefen, dela mekabbela harekava mimmin achara, delav ihi minah. vehay solet ben deroe malka ihi yatva, belula beshemen katit. (ad kan raya mehemana).

(Uvechibbura kadmaa) belula beshemen katit, beshemen, behahu shemen denagid venafik milleella. amar rabbi shimon, yaut amrat. aval may katit. ella raza illaa ihu. dechevan deihu shemen, may katit. ella remez hu deka ramiz leshammesha benukeba, leangeda legabbah shemen katit kaddeka yaut lah, la havi ella katit (sefer acher ella raza illaa hu, deka ramiz laanagedaa legabbah shemen katit kedka yeot la), leappaka mizzetim, deinnun shayyfin degufa, uleamshacha hahu negidu milleella, bechol shayyfa veshayyfa. (lo have ella katit)

Raya mehemna (shayych lekamman sof 73 0) amar raya mehemana, butztzina kadisha, kamma metikin milach, vaday ittemar hacha, belula beshemen katit. veittemar hatam, beorayyta debal pe, belula bamikra, bamishna, battalmud. veod it raza tinyayna, belula beshemen katit. vadday lav orayyta ihi belula. ella leman desavil kama machteshin beginah. kema deukemuha mare matnitin, delet orayyta mitkayyemet, ella bemi shememit garmeh alah. veod amru, bizman sheatta mechatet raglecha mimmedina lamdina, tizke lirot pene shechina.
1525: Ketishin, veappik mikkol innun shayyfin illain, deinnun zetin kadishin, meshach revu betiuveta shelim, legabbe nukeveh. vei la katish, la yippuk hahu mishcha, ella bela tiuveta deshayyfin, vehahu negidu, la ithane minneh nukeba, vela havi kaddeka yaut, ad dethe belula minneh mikkol shayyfin. veal da belula beshemen katit, leithanaa uleitzena minneh. (amar raya mehemana)

Katit, da hu dimkayyem pat bamelach tochal, (Yechezkel 4:11) umayim bammesura tishte. veod belula beshemen katit, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 53:5) vehu mecholal mippeshaenu medukka meavonotenu. veod belula beshemen katit, da tzadik chay almin, denagid tippin kadishin, deinnun pirurin kazzetim, mimmocha illaa, deinnun chad issaron lokovel 10. ushene esronim, 10 10. ushelosha esronim lappar, 10 10 10. veinnun issaron lakkeves, 8 esronim laayil, ushelosha esronim lappar.

Veraza demilla amru betaaniot, en tippa yoredet millemala, sheen olin kenegdah tippayyim. veinnun beraza da ... uremizu dilhon lekavel telat mochin. chad moach hazikkaron. tinyayna moach hamachashava. telitaa moach haddimyon. haddimyon vehazikkaron salkin min libba hamachshavit nachta al libba umekabbelin lah alayyhu kemalka begin dehay adam deihu machashava derachiv veshalit al cheva telitaa venachit alah legabbe teren chevavn ufatchin gadfayyhu lekabbela lah kegon cholem al tzere itavid segolta veda keter elyon al chachma uvina.

Issaron ushene esronim, remizin litlat chevan demerkavta illaa. deinnun: gedula, gevura, tiferet. shelosha esronin, remizin: lenetztzach, hod, yesod. mirkevet hammishne. reviit hahin: da malchut kadisha, Adonai reviaa min shem Adonai. deihu arba anpe adam. (ad kan raya mehemana).
Reviit hahin, ragla reviaa lechurseyay illaa, veihu ola tamid legabbeh bechol yoma veyoma, ad machashavta illaa, delet lah sof. uvegin da, ola ka atya al hirhur hallev.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa amar, raya mehemana, hahi taga dezarka, ihi yod, reviit. uf hachi bachayya dishmah adam, dearba anpin dileh deinnun Adonai, makkaf shofar holech segolta. telat chevan, deinnun teresar shevatin. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Uvechibbura kadmaa, olat tamid, ihi regel reviaa lechurseyay illaa, da ola tamid bechol yom, meinnun yomin shit divreshit. beshabbat al chad teren, begin deyitosaf bah nehiru ushelema kaddeka yaut, veha ittemar.

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, malchu. beshit sefiran ihi ola tamid legabbe 6, deachid behon. ben yah, ganiz babbina. uvean sefira meinnun shit selikat legabbeh. beyoma telitaa, deikre tiferet. divyom hashshabbat itosaf immeh nefesh yetera, deihi bina. Adonai illaa. 10 ot beshabbat, chachma illaa. melech meuttar becheter, uvegin da, bitfilat musaf keter yittenu lecha.

Uverashe chadshechem, vechi kama reshin it lah lesihara. ella innun teren nekudin, kegavvna da nekuda tattaa sihara, teren reshin dilah, teren nekudin deinnun alah, segol. bekadmita hava keter ale tere malchin kegavvna da, vahavat segolta. ulevatar deamart i efshar lishne melachim lehishtamesh becheter echad, amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu, lechi umaati et atzmech. unechitat leragloy ditren melachim, kegavvna da vehayeynu segol, ma dahavat segolta, ithadderat segol.

Veraza demilla, lokovel teren nekudin, deinnun teren melachim, ka ramiz parim bene vakar shenayim, velokovel nekuda atara al reshayyhu, amar, veayil echad, kemo keter echad. batar deamrat i efshar lishne melachim sheyishtammeshu becheter echad, azirat garmah uf hachi, useir izzim echad lechattat. ayil deyitzchak, ithaddar sair. ithappach merachame ledina, veitzeir.

Uvegin da sair izzim echad lechattat, velo amar leola, lemehevi keter. umenalan deit yerida bachattat, shenneemar (Vayikra 9:22) vayyered measot hachattat. vaamay shattaf ola im chattat bayyerida. ella leolfa, deola havat bekadmita middat harachamim, ulevatar ithappechat ledina bayyerida, veitkeriat chattat, vecholla chad.
1526: Kappara, alay havat sihara keter vadday, kegavvna da ulevatar itmeitat, venachtat leraglin dileh, kegavvna da uvezimna da haviu alay kappara, ittemar bah, (Vayikra 6) hi haola, selikat meragloy. deittemar bah, (Yeshayahu 66:1) vehaaretz hadom raglay. lememar bah, hashshamayim kisi. vehay ihu raza, (Shmuel 2 23:3) tzaddik moshel yirat elohim. dimhappech dina lerachame. veraza demilla, (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna. kegavvna da, 24. yedod.

Veod, keves 1 ushene kevasim bene shana temimim, lokovel telat sefiran. shiva kevasim bene shana, lokovel sheva sefiran. shiva kevasim, innun 7 yomin desihara. bene shana, benoy desihara, deikre shana. deihi chada meinnun shanim kadmoniyyot. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Uverashe chadshechem vegomer. vechi kama rashin innun lesihara. veha let resha lesihara, ella shimsha, deihu resha legabbah. ella rashe teren bechol yarcha veyarcha. veinnun yaakov veyosef, demitchaddete al sihara. veal da bau lechaddeta lah.

Parim bene vakar shenayim, illen innun deamra sihara, dehech yishtamshun bah kachada, veazirat garmah techotayyhu. veayil echad, da ayil deyitzchak. vechi avraham lean azil. ella begin deittear tamman esav, itkenish avraham, dela yecheme leh, uman ihu sair derosh chodesh. (tere navesachey) uvegin dezammin leitteara tamman esav deihu sair itkenish avraham, vela ishtechach tamman, yitzchak, ishtechach tamman, dirchimu dileh legabbeh, kechamra al duredyeh. yaakov ishtechach tamman, letavra anpoy. yosef deihu shor (sefer acher satan) dileh, legabbe rachel.

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemna, vadday bene shana itkeriu al shem chamma, (nusach acher malchut) imma kaddisha, deittemar bah pene moshe kifne chamma. (sefer acher sihara deikre shana deit bah 355 yomin, kechushevan) shana it bah 365 yomin, kechusheban 365 lo taase. veihu al da lismala. imma illaa, sihara bimina. asura beratta leabba deihu limina chesed. veihi kelila 288 pikudin. ishtechach 6 im imma lismala. beratta im abba limina dechesed. (veihi kelila 288 pikkudin. ishtechach 6 im ema, beratta im abba limina) veraza demilla, (Mishlei 3:19) bechachma yasad eretz. chachma abba. eretz beratta. konen shamayim deihu bera, im imma deihu tevuna, vehay ihu 24, havayot beemtza.

Veod useir izzim echad, teren seirin innun, deittemar alayyhu (Vayikra 16:8) velakach et shene hasseirim vegomer goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazel. sair laAdonai, begin miut sihara, veihu sair echad laydod lechattat. echad: missitra deyichuda. aval sair daazazel, la ketiv beh echad, la karban, vela ishshe, vela ola. ella veshillach beyad ish itti hammidbara. veshillach, kidamar yaakov (Bereshit 32:19) mincha hi shelucha ladoni leesav. uf hachi shochad, letavra rugeza desamael, dela yitkeriv lemakdesha lekatrega.

Lechalba deihu raev, uman devae dela nashich leh, yahiv leh bisra lemechal, o nahama, veyashke leh mayya. veraza demilla, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem vegomer. uveda yithaddar rechimu debar nash, dela dayy dela nashich leh bechamma yissurin, ella ithaddar lemehevi leh sannegora, veithaddar rechimoy.

Vaamay havo shalchin leh beyad ish itti, pagim. begin desitrin acharanin kullehu mare mumin, veitkeriu seirim, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:21) useirim yerakkedu sham. veittemar behon, (Vayikra 17:7) velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim. dealayyhu ittemar, (Devarim 32:17) yizbechu lashshedim lo eloah. uvesair da, itperash mikkolla, venose kol chovin deyisrael aleh, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam. veod, batar denatil ihu venasa. kudesha berich hu nose avon. (Shemot 34:7) may ben nose lenasa. nasa: matula. nose: seliku dematula. (uvechibbura kadmaa) (ad kan 310)

Ushelosha esronim, telat dargin kadmain dilah, dechol chad vechad eser, kegavvna dilella esronim, chad measara. useir chattat echad, amay ikre chattat. begin deihu chattat, umissitra dechattat hu. amar ribbi elazar, veha ketiv laAdonai.
1527: Ella laAdonai itkeriv vadday, dichtiv lechapper. letavra anpin, vecholla yitkeriv lemakdesha, ella yahave chulaka chada lesamael, veachil leh, vela achid bishar karbenin. veda ihu lechodeh, dela ishtetaf achara immeh lemechal beh.

Ihu ithane bego seudata demalka bechulaka da, veal da chadde, veitperash miyisrael, vela mekatrega alayyhu. vei lav dehava miuta desihara, la havo yahave leh bisudata demalka kelum. vechi bemiuta desihara may ka avid. ella begin dekariv veyanik, venatil chela leammeh, miggo setar semala desihara, veittekaf beh. uvesair da itperash mikkolla, veithane behay. uvegin dekudesha berich hu azir lah lesihara, mekarvin leh lehay sair, begin deyitperash minnah, vela yitkeriv lemakdesha. veal da tanenan, haviu alay kappara. alay: begine, deazirat lah, begin sibbat dili attun tzerichin da.

Raya mehemna (Bamidbar 28:11) uverashe chadshechem, innun yaakov veyosef. (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef, dimchaddete al sihara. ashkachna besifra dechanoch deamar, kema divrosh chodesh, deitdakkiat sihara leitkarva bevalah, itzterich lemehav lesitra achara chulaka chada, behahu zina dilah. uf hachi name itzterichat leitteta, beshaata deitdakkiat leitkarva bevalah, lemehav chulaka chada lesitra achara, behahu zina dileh.

Uman ihu. hahu chulaka tuferaha betinnufa dilhon. uzeer meresh desaara, begin devae leasreka resha, uleachrecha lon da beda, vela yezil avatrah hahu sitra bisha, leavasha lah, veitperash minnah bechol sitrin. uma taavid, mehahu saara vetuferin. levatar detachrich lon kachada, itzterich leanacha lon baatar dela avrin tamman bene nasha, o bego chorin tattain dachatzera, vetagniz lon tamman. (veod uverashe chadshechem amro, shayych kan)

Veod uverashe chadshechem amru rabbanan dematnitin, dechad havo mekaddeshin yarchin al pi bet din, havo massiin massuot berashe heharim, vahavu amrin kaze ree vekaddesh. lezimnin sihara havat kegavvna da hava mistakkela leela bekarna. ulezimnin mistakkela letatta kegoona da lezimnin mistakkela lemizrach kegoona da 20 lezimnin lemaarav kegoona da lezimnin ledarom ulezimnin latztzafon vehay ihu 20 istakkelutah dilah leshit sitrin dechalil lon tiferet deihu 6 gedulla gevura tiferet. netzach hod yesod.
Nekuda denagid aleh millego, hi chachma. vehahi chut deaschar alah, ihu keter. vehahi nekuda ihu lezimnin atara, ulezimnin kisse, lemetav aleh, lezimnin sherafraf lahadom raglav.

Vaamay itkeriat levana. al shem libbun hahalacha, deihi millego, (Tehillim 45:14) kol kevudda bat melech penima. uveeshsha devina denachit ala ihi mitlabbenat. veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu. umay dahavat adonay dina, sumaka bigvura, detamman bina. itlabbenat missitra dechesed, detamman chachma, veithadderat yedod.

Uma garim leithappecha middina lerachame tzaddikim gemurim desihara missitra deetz haddaat tov vara, ihi kelifa dileh chashucha, im baheret shechora, hi yetzer hara, shifcha. (Vayikra 13) ushefala enenna vehi keha, velet lah midilah, ella hahu chut denahir bah, deihu livva lah belelya, deihi galuta. veitavar minnah bimama, deihu alma deate, deveh (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha.

Aval sihara deetz hachayyim, hahi nekudda dilgav minnah, ihi kemabbua delet leh pesak, dichtiv bah, (Yeshayahu 58:11) uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav. veitkeriat ayyelet ahavim missitra dechesed, dehayynu (Yirmeyahu 31:3) ahavat olam ahavtich al ken meshachtich chesed. uteren karnayin it lah min nehora, kegavvna da lezimnin haachat gavoah min hashenit kegoona da: lezimnin karnin inun shavin. (ad kan raya mehemana).
1528: Uvachodesh harishon vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 42:2) keayyal taarog al afike mayim ken nafshi taarog elecha elohim. hay kera okmuha, ketiv hacha ayyal uchetiv hatam ayyelet begin deit dechar veit nukeba (veaf al gav deit dechar venukeba, kola chad. hay ayil, ihu ikre dechar. veihu ikre nukeba. hada hu dichtiv keayyal taarog velo ketiv yaarog. vecholla chad. ayyelet hashshachar).

May ayyelet hashshachar. ella da ihi chayya chada rachamanit, delet bechol chevan dealma rachamanit kevavtah. begin divshaata didchikat lah shaata, veitzterichat limzona lah ulechol chevan. ihi azlat lemerachik leorach rechika. veatiat veovilat mezona. vela baat lemechal, ad detete vetithadar leatraha. amay. begin deyitkanshun legavah shear chevan, utechalek lon mehahu mezona. vechad atat, mitkanneshin legabbah kol shear chevan, vehi kayyeyma beemtzaita, ufalgat lechol chad vechad. vesiman, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vegomer. umimma difligat lon, ihi sava, keillu achla yattir mechla mikkolla. (ematay feligat lon).

Vechad yete tzafra deikre shachar. yete lah chavalim degaluta. uvegin da, itkeriat ayyelet hashshachar. al shem kadruta detzafra. dachavalim lah kayyoleda. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:17) kemo hara takriv laledet tachil tizak bachavaleha vegomer. (amar raya mehemana behahu zimna shayych achare ze)

Ematay palgat lehon. kad tzafra bae lemete. beod deihi lelya, vekadruta selikat leanhara. kema deat amer, vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vegomer. kevan deanhir tzafra, kullehu savin bimzona dilah.

Keden, kala chada itar beemtzaita dirkia, kare bechayil veamar, kerivin ulu leduchetayychu. rechikin. puku. kol chad vechad lichnush leatreh deitchaze leh. kevan deanhir shimsha, kol chad vechad itkenish leatreh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:22) tizrach hashshemesh yeasefun vegomer. veihi azlat bimama, veitgalya belelya. ufalga betzafra. uvegin kach ikre, ayyelet hashshachar.
Levatar ittatkefat kegibbar veazlat, veikre ayyal. lean atar azlat. azlat shitin parse mehahu

Raya mehemna vei tema dil tachil ulev shenin olidat, batar elef umatan, kechusheban 272. ha ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:7) beterem tachil yalada. veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 65:24) vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene od vegomer. umay (sefer acher yoma) beterem. ella kodem deyishtelimu, shivin uteren shenin, batar elef umatan, innun chavalim deyoleda, yitgalyayn 2 meshichin bealma. uvehahu zimna (Tehillim 29:9) uvehechalo kullo omer kavod, veha okmuha (Mishlei 3:35) kavod chachamim yinchalu.

Behahi shaata, illen mare tora yihon nichbadim. illen disvilu kama chavalim vetztzirin kayyoleda, vahavu mevuzzin ben amme haaretz, yehon nichbadim. umiyyad (Tehillim 29:10) Adonai lammabbul yashav, lerashiaya. en mabbul, ella dinin demabbul. kegavvna deniftachu (Bereshit 7:11) mayeynot tehom vaarubbot hashshamayim niftechu beyome tufena, uf hacha yitarun dinin legabbayyhu ella vetatta, ad delet sof vetachlit, vechol bizzuyin ukelana, deavdu umin ovde kochavim umazzalot dealma, leshem Adonai uleammeh, vechamma cherufin disvilu yisrael minnayyhu al shem Adonai, mikkullehu natil nukema kudesha berich hu, veal da itkere, (Nachum 1:2) nokem Adonai venoter uvaal chema legabbayyhu.

Uvachodesh harishon, man rishon. da nisan. tamman olidat hahi chayya, lekayyem ma deokmuha mare matnitin, benisan nigalu uvenisan atidin lehiggael. uveyd dileh, (Shemot 17:16) vayyomer ki yad al kes yah, tamman ome leabera mealma zara deesav amalekiyyim, behahu zimna (Shemot 12:21) mishchu ukechu lachem tzon lemishpechotechem veshachatu happasach. mishchu: (Hoshea 7:Adonai) mashach yado et lotztzetztzim.

Behahu zimna, ko amar Adonai laroim happoshim bi. veomer, (Yechezkel 13:9) veel admat yisrael lo yavou. veillen innun roim deana, parnase dara. uvegin da ittemar alayyhu, (Hoshea 2:16) hinne anochi mefatteha veholachtiha hammidbara. (Yechezkel 20:36) venishpatti ittechem vegomer, kaasher nishpatti et avotechem dekatil lon bemakkat choshech. (ad kan raya mehemana)
1529: Atar denafka, vealat lego tura dachashocha. (umittamman orchat mezona) azlat bego hahu tura dachashocha, arach leraglah chivya chada akima, veazil leraglah. veihi salleka mittamman, legabbe tura dinhora. kevan dematat tamman, zammin lah kudesha berich hu chivya achara, venafik umekatrega da beda, veihi ishtezivat. umittamman natlat mezona, vetavat leatrah, befalgut lelya. umippalgu lelya, sharya lefalga, ad dislikat kadruta detzafra. kevan deanhir yemama, azlat, vela itchaziat, kema deittemar.

Uveshaata dealma itzterich lemitra, mitkanneshin legabbah kol shear chevan, vehi selikat leresh tura ramaa, veitattefat reshaha ben birchaha, vegaat goa batar goa, vekudesha berich hu shama kollah, veitmele rachamin, vechas al alma. vehi nachtat meresh tura, verahatat, utemirat garmaha. vechol shear chevata abbatraha rahatin, vela mashkechin lah. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:2) keayyal taarog al afike mayim. may al afike mayim. al afike mayim mehanehu deityebashu, vealma tzache al mayyay, keden taarog.

Beshaata deitabberat, astimat, kevan demata zimna lemelad, gaat veramat kalin, kala batar kala, ad shivin kalin, kechusheban tevin (Tehillim 20:2) deyaancha Adonai beyom tzara, deihi shirata deubbarta da. vekudesha berich hu shama lah, vezammin legabbah. keden appik chad chivya ravreva, miggo ture chashuch veate ben turin, pumeh melachacha beafra, mate ad hay ayyal, veate venashich lah behahu atar, tere zimne.

Zimna kadmaa nafik dama, veihi lachich. zimna tinyayna, nafik mayyay veshatu kol innun beiran di beturayay, veitpatchat veolidat. vesimanich (Bamidbar 20:11) vayyach et hassela bemattehu paamayim. uchetiv vattesht haeda uveiram.

Behahu zimna dekudesha berich hu chas alah al (sefer acher ovada) ubbarta denachash (sefer acher dechayya) da. ma ketiv, (Tehillim 29:9) kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot vayyechesof yearot vegomer, kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot, innun chavalin vetzirin, leatteara innun shivin kalin. miyyad vayyechesof yearot, leabara (nusach acher leitteara) hahu nachash, uleitgalyay hahi chayya benayyhu lemehach. uvehechalo, may uvehechalo. behechalo dekudesha berich hu, kol innun achlusin, patchin veamrin kavod. may kavod. (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo.

(Bamidbar 28:16) uvachodesh harishon, man chodesh harishon. da ihu chodesh, dehay chayya itgalyay beh veitatkefat beh, venafka lealma bearbaa asar yom. bearbaa asar, illen shear chevavta, deinnun 10 10 lechol setar, bed sitrin dealma. uvesifre kadmae, ihu 10, vechad lechol setar learba sitrin, veinnun arba asar. kevan deinnun arba, mitchabberan umittakkenan im innun eser divsitra dimina, keden 14, bechedva leittakna chayya da (sefer acher leatkena sihara chayya da) betikkunaha.

Ribbi elazar amar, vadday hachi hu. veta chaze, ketiv (Shemot 12:21) mishchu ukechu lachem tzon vegomer, mishchu, (bechibbura kadmaa) may mishchu. keman demashich meatar achara, laatar da. mishchu yomin illain legabbe yomin tattain. yomin illain innun 366,

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, millin illen setimin, vetzarich lemiftach lon legabbe chavrayyay, deman desatim lon genizin deorayyta, ihu metzaer lon. dilrashiayay nehorin derazin, itchazran lon chashochin. veihu matla lemamona deihu ganiz, man dechafar leh, ad degalle leh, velav ihu dileh, ithaddar besucheltanuteh bachashocha vekavla. uleman deihu dileh, nahir leh. uvegin da, it lebar nash legallaa razin setimin divorayyta.
Beasor: 9 innun lechol setar, lokovel 9 yarchin deyoleda, kechusheban 9. man yoledet. 4 min echad. 9, ihu 9, led sitrin deat 4, veinnun arbaim. 9 zachor, 4 shamor. ha arbein uteren.
Ishtear kavod, deittemar beh baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. veihu kavod 32, 4 zimnin lechol setar deat 4, hare 64 led sitrin, 256. veokmuha, kavod leella, 32 letatta. uvegin da
1530: Kechusheban mishchu. yomin tattain, zimnin deinnun 355, uvezimna, deitnahara sihara beashlemuta, seliku lemeheve innun yomin 365, kechusheban mishchu chaser chad.

Mishchu yomin illain legabbe yomin tattain, lemehevi kullehu kachada bechibbura chada. uman mashich lon. innun eser delistar yemina, dichtiv beasor. beasor, baasara mibbae leh, may beasor. ella (tetzavve 180 amud alef) 9 innun lechol setar, unekudda chada deazla beemtzaita. kegavvna da, vehahi nekuda ashlimat leeser veal da beasor kema deitmar zachor veshamor leshimusha baasara inun yomin tesha behahu nekuda. lachodesh hazze yomin delistar yemina begin leitchabbera zot baze lemehavi kolla chad.

Uvezimna deinnun 4 itkeshsharu led sitrin (mitchabberan) bahadayyhu. keden olidat hahu chayya vechivya azil leh uvehahu zimna mekaddeshin leella lehay chayya vekaran lah kavod. ucheden itkaddash moada. ma dela hava ad hasheta, uchean karan lah kavod, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:9) uvehechalo kullo omer kavod. (amar raya mehemana milin illen shayych kan)

Meyaychadin bechol yoma teren zimnin, deamaran behu teren zimnin kavod, deihu 64. uteren zimnin 4 4 min echad, hare amud bet. hare 4 deechad, shelimu demv shemahan. ushelimu dev shemahan. uvegin da amrin bemizmor ledavid (Tehillim 24:8) mi ze melech hakkavod Adonai izuz vegibbor. uvezimna tinyayna mi hu ze melech hakkavod. (ad kan raya mehemana) (amar raya mehemana milin illen shayych kan).

Man hechalo. da hechol illaa penimaa, detamman mitkaddesha kolla. tamman mekaddeshin leman dechaze leitkaddesha. hech mekaddeshin leh behahu hechala. bekadmita itpetachu tarin, vechad maftecha setima, atkin ufatach tara chad, listar darom, keden al kahana rabba behahu pitcha, veizderaz behemyenoy, vetikkunoy. veitattar beitra dikdushsha ulevish choshna veefoda, umeila deshivin zagin verimmonin, deinnun (Shemot 28:34) paamon zahav verimmon. vetzitz nizra dekudesha al mitzcheh, deitkere tzitz nezer hakkodesh, veitkeshat bed bigde zahav, uved bigde lavan. veal hahu tzitz 42 atvavn melahatan beh, umenatztzetzan aleh, venahir kol hahu hechala binhorin illain. (raya mehemana istechar hahu hechala lekamman vechulei)

Istechar hahu maftecha, ufatach sitra achara devistar tzafon, keden al levi, masera deyaakov, deafrish lekudesha berich hu. vechinnor deeser nimin immeh, veitattar beitroy, ucheden istechar maftecha, ufatach behahu hechala chad tara, hahu tara dekayyeyma beemtzaita, ammuda delistar mizrach

Istechar hahu hechala, ufatach tara achara distar darom (davar acher tzafon) beshivin uteren itrin. levatar aftach tara telitaa, listar mizrach, bechamshin (uteren) nehorin, dechamshin tarin devina. levatar aftach tara achara delistar tzafon (davar acher meerev), bev itrin, vechullehu 248 bechusheban tevin defarshiyayn dikriat shema. uma divkadmeta hahi chayya havat zeera, behahu zimna itreviat, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:3) melo kol haaretz kevodo, deihu kavod illaa vetattaa.

Kad mate lechay almin, deveh 18 birchan ditzlota, ufatach beh (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach ufi yaggid tehillatecha. keden ammuda deemtzaita, itchabbar bahadah bechavivu denshikin desifvavn, veinnun netzach vehod, delashon ihu tzaddik benayyhu. leshon limudim behahu zimna, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, keden karan lehahi chayya kavod kevod abba veimma, mekuddash mekuddash. keden yarcha itkaddesha kaddeka yaut, keden uvachodesh harishon rishon vadday.

Ucheden mishchu. veal da beasor lachodesh hazze, deitchabbar sihara kaddisha beshimsha. deittemar beh, (Tehillim 84:12) ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim (tzevaot). uma dahavat nekuda zeera, (sefer acher kegavvna da) itmalleat besihara, ucheden ihi hachodesh male.
1531: Al veitattar beshivin itrin, veitattar bearba atvavn, deinnun teresar. veitattar begillufin dematan ve elef almin, veitattar beitrin desayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma, bechamma levushe yekar, bechamma itrin kaddishin.

Istechar hahu maftecha, ufatach leh kol tarin genizin, vechol tarin dikdushin temirin, veitkaddash behu, vekayyeyma tamman kemalka. mitberach bechamma birchan, mitatter bechamma itrin. keden nafke kullehu bechibbura chada, mitatteran beitrayyhu kaddeka yaut. kevan denafke ittear leh bekishutoy.

Vehay chayya itteara, veazirat garmah, miggo rechimu deshirata, hech azarat garmah miggo rechimu deshirata, azarat garmah zeer zeer, ad deitavedat nekudda chada. kevan deihi azirat garmah, (beshirta) keden ketiv, (Shemot 2:1) vayyelech ish mibbet levi vayyikkach et bat levi. bat levi vadday, missitra dismala. heach achid lah. oshit semala techot resha miggo chavivu.

Vei tema, kevan deihi nekudda chada, ech yachil leachada binkudda zeera. ella legabbe ella, kol ma dehu milla zeera, da tushebachta, veda illuyay verav birvu illaa. miyyad kahana rabba ittear lah, veachid lah, vechavik lah, deilu havavt ravreva, la yachlin leachada kelal. aval kevan deazirat garmah, veihi nekudda chada, keden achadin bah, vesallekin lah leella, kevan desallekin lah, veyatva ben teren sitrin illen, keden hahu ammuda dekayyeyma beemtzaita, itchabbar bahadah bechavivu dinshikin, birchimu dechibbura chada. keden (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, birchimu denshikin mitdabbekan da beda, bela piruda, ad denakta nafsha deinnugin kaddeka yaut.

Beshaata denakta nafsha deinnugin kaddeka yaut, uvaya lefakda lechelaha, mitkanneshin kullehu, vekaryayn lah miggo hechala kaddisha, kavod kavod kavod. behechala kaddisha abba veimma, patche veamre mekuddash mekuddash. keden yarcha itkadash kaddeka yaut. ucheden ketiv, uvachodesh harishon, rishon vday, veal da mishchu vegomer. veal da beasor lachodesh hazze, deitchabbar sihara beshimsha, uma dahavat (nakta) nekudda chada, kad nachta itpeshat zeer zeer, veitmalleyay, veitavidat Adonai, malyay mikkol sitrin, mitkaddesha kaddeka yaut.
Vesihara itmalleyay kegavvna da. male kol haaretz kevodo. bekadmita chaser, uchean bishlimu. (ad kan raya mehemana) (Rabbi chiyyay patach vechulei)

Ribbi chiyyay patach, bearbaa asar yom lachodesh pesach vegomer. imra deihu pischa amay. ella dachala demitzrae, veelaha dilhon, hava imra. begin demitzrae palchin lemazzal tale, uvegin kach palchin leimra. ta chaze, ketiv (Shemot 8:22) hen nizbach et toavat mitzrayim. may toavat mitzrayim. vechi al desanin leh, ketiv toavat mitzrayim. ella dachala demitzrae, veelaha dilhon, ikre toavat mitzrayim. kema dichtiv, (Devarim 18:9) ketoavot haggoyim, dachala dishar ammin.

Ta chaze chachmeta deyosef, dichtiv, (Bereshit 47:2) umiktze echav lakach chamishsha anashim, veolif lon lememar, anshe mikne hayu avadecha. vechi malka dehava shallit al kol ara, veabba lemalka, avid keda, veavid laachoy deyisneun

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, kegon lishana deihu makkel lechol anshe beteh, veihu lishana deat 6, veihu mate deveh eser otiot, uveh macha kudesha berich hu al yedoy 10 machan. uvegin dechol machan havo missitra de Adonai, ribbi akiva omer, minnayin shekkol makka umakka shehevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitztzerim bemitztzerayim hayta shel chamesh makkot vechulei, emor meatta vechulei. veat Adonai salleka beat 10 lechamshin machan, chamesh zimnin chamshin, innun 250. uvegin da, veal hayyam laku 250 makkot.
Amar yosef, kol metav eretz mitzrayim raamses hi, vehahi ara afrishu ladechalen dilhon, leraya ulemehach bechol innugin dealma. vechol mitzrae chasheybevan leinun darean
1532: Lehon, vela yachshevun lehon. (lemebad lehon roe tzon) ella vadday toavat mitzrayim, dachala veelaha dilhon ikre hachi, veal da ketiv, (Shemot 8:22) hen nizbach et toavat mitzrayim.

Amar yosef, kol (Bereshit 47) metav mitzrayim hi eretz rameses, vehahi ara afrishu ledachala dilhon, leraya ulemehach bechol innugin dealma. vechol mitzrae chashivu leinnun deraan ledachalehon, kedachalehon. aavid leachay deyartun hahi ara, veyisgedun lon mitzrae, veyachshevun lon kaddeka yaut. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 47:3) ki toavat mitzrayim kol roe tzon, mechashshevin lon kedachalehon.

Amar ribbi yose, veha tanenan kema deitpera kudesha berich hu meinnun defalche leavoda zara, hachi itpera meavoda zara mammash, vechi yosef avid laachoy avoda zara. amar leh, la avid yosef laachoy avoda zara, ella avid lon leshalletaa al avoda zara dilhon, uleachpeya avoda zara dilhon techot yedayyhu, uleraddaa lon bammakkel. (amar raya mehemana kegon, besof daf shekkodem ze) amar yosef, i yishletun achay al avoda zara dilhon, kol shekken deyishletun al garmayyhu, uvegin kach otiv lon bemetav ara, veashlit lon al kol ara.

Veal da imra deihu pesach amay. ella dachala demitzrae, veelaha dilhon hava imra. amar kudesha berich hu, mibbeasor lachodesh sivu dachala dilhon demitzrae, vetifsu leh, vihe asur vetafis bitfisa dilchon, yoma chad uteren veg, uveyoma 4, appiku leh ledina, veitkenashu aleh.

Uveshaata demitzrae havo shamin kal dachala dilhon, detafis bitfisa deyisrael, vela yachlin leshezava leh, havo bachan, vahava kashya alayyhu, keillu garmayyhu itakidu lekatla. amar kudesha berich hu, yihye tafis birshutayychu, yoma batar yoma, arbaa yomin, begin diyechomun yateh tafis, uveyoma reviaa appiku leh lekatla, veyechomun leh mitzrae hech attun avdin beh dina, veda kashya lehu min kol machteshe deavad lon kudesha berich hu, innun dinin deyaavdun bedachalehon.

Ladechaleyhevan, kadechaleyhevan. veda shail yosef mipparo, leshalletaa achoy al dachalan demitzrae, deitkafyayn techot yedeh, kaavadim batar malchehon, lemeheve kullehu mitkafyayn techot sham Adonai masetareyhevan, velo shallit bealma ella sham Adonai. veitkafyayn kol memanan techot yedeh.

Uleachazaa lon, deihu atid laaytepareaa minnehon, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 12:12) uvechol elohe mitzrayim eese shefatim ani Adonai. kad mateayyn laberayyn veavdin garmayyhu elohot. uvegin datelah memana dileh, ihu rav al kol memanan deelohim acherim, minni kudsha berich hu leyisrael, (Shemot 12:3) vayyikchu lahem ish se levet avot se levet, veashlit lon aleh, vetofse leh, tapeysh batepayshah dilhon yoma uteren utelat. ulevatar da appiku leh ledina leene kol mitzrae, leachazaa deelaha dilhon birshu deyisrael lemebad beh dina.

Begin da, (Shemot 12:9) el tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevashshel bammayim ki im tzali esh rosho al keraav veal karvu, lemeheve dan baesh tzali, umane lazerakea legarmeh dileh beshuka bevizzuy. uvegin da, (Shemot 12:46) veetzem lo tishberu bo. umane leyoma reviaa, batar dehava tapeysh 3 yomin kashur, lemebad beh dina. veda kashya lon mikkol machtashin dimcha lon kudsha berich hu, al yeda dareaya mehemna. velo od, ella demane dela lemechal leh betiuveta. umiyyad dechaman garmoy beshuka, vela yachlin leshezava leh, da kashya lon mikkolla. velo od, ella deittemar behu, (Shemot 12:11) umakkelchem beyedchem, laatakepayya kol dachalan demitzrae, techot yedayyhu. uvegin deinhu bechorot memanan, ketiv (Shemot 12:29) vaAdonai hikka kol bechor.

Batar kol da ketiv, (Devarim 16:3) lo yiachel chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni. uchetiv (Shemot 12:20) kol machmetztzet lo tochelu. amar raya mehemana, amay mane dela lemechal chametz shivat yomin, ulemechal behon matztza. vaamay lo yiachel, vaamay lo tochelu. ella 7 kochve lechet veinnun: shtztzm 108. veinnun missitra detov vara, nehora dilgo matztza. kelifa dilvar chametz. veinnun chametz dechar machmetztzet nukeba.
Matztza dilgo shemura. veinnun, (Ester 2:9) sheva hannearot haruyot latet lah mibbet hammelech. veittemar alayyhu,
1533: Benura, dichtiv, (Devarim 7:25) pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh. amar kudesha berich hu, al tochlu mimmennu na. dela yemrun biruta uvetiuveta dedachalna, achlin leh hachi. ella atkinu leh tzali, velo mevushal, deilu mevushal yehe tamir, vela yechomun leh, ella tikkuna dileh deyechemun leh hachi mokda benura, begin derecheh nodef.

Vetu resheh aleh kafuf al karsuloy, dela yemrun dechayya, o milla achara hu, ella deyishtemodun leh, deihu dachala dilhon. vetu, dela yechlun leh. betiuveta, ella al sava, orach kelana uvizzayon. vetu, etzem lo tishberu vo, ella deyechemun garmoy raman beshuka, vela yechlun leshezava leh. veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 33:4) uvelohehem asa Adonai shefatim. dinin saggiin. tu umakkelchem beyedchem, vela charba veromcha ushear mane kerava.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ha okmuha, demitzrae palche lemazzal tale, uvegin kach palchin leimra. amar ribbi yose, i hachi, tale yiflechun, vela imra. amar leh, kolla palchin, ella mazzal tale nachit vesalik betale veimra, uvegin kach palchin lecholla. amar leh hachi shemana, dechol beira rabba (sefer acher detzon) dachala dilhon hava, veal da katil kudesha berich hu kol bechor behema. veha ittemar deillen innun dargin dilella, deikrun hachi.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Shemot 12:20) kol machmetzet lo tochelu, uchetiv (Shemot 13:3) lo yeachel chametz. ella da dechar, veda nukeba. amar rabbi shimon, elazar beri, beda (ze shayych bareaya mehemana achar karbena) ketiv lo tochelu, uveda ketiv lo yeachel, amay la ketiv lo tochlu. ella, nukeba deihi astiat archaha, beazhara vday, dechar deihu achid bechuta dedachyu yattir, bevakkasha. veal da ketiv, lo yeachel, lo tochelu.

Amar leh abba, veha ketiv (Devarim 16:3) lo tochal alav chametz. amar leh, asge tavin yeterin likara lekarbena. aval bekadmita bevakkasha lo yeachel. aval levatar beazhara, lo tochlu, dehu kashya mittarvavyyhu. machmetzet may tama. begin derecha demota it tamman. chametz, dechar. machmetzet, nukeba. (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavt, beresha vesefa deteva, tishkach lah. uvegin da man deachil chametz bappesach, ihu akdimat leh mota, velinda demit hu bealma den, uvealma deate, ketiv (Shemot 12:15) venichreta hannefesh hahi.

Matztza, amay (sefer acher itkeriat matztza). ella hachi tanenan, shadday: begin deamar leolamo day, deyomar letzarotenu day. uf hachi matztza, begin deka meshadded demavrachat lechol sitrin bishin, veavid ketata behu, kegavvna deshadday dimzuza, demavriach leshedim umazzikim detara, uf hachi ihi mavrachat lon mikkol mishkene kedushsha, veavid meriva uketata behu. kema deat amer, (Shemot 17:7) massa umeriva. al da ketiv matztza. veha massa besamech ihu. ella targumo demassa, ihu matzuta.
(Shemot 12:17) ushemartem et hammatztzot. matztza ihi shemura levalah, deihu 6. uveh itavid mitztzeva.

Uman denatir lah legabbe yah, dignizin bemtz min matztza, veinnun. 50 95. umane kudesha berich hu levarech lah sheva berachot lel pesach, deinnun sheva hannearot dilah, shtztzm 108. umane leavera minnehon chametz umachmetztzet, deinnun ananim chashuchin dimchasseyayn al nehorin, deshiva kochve lechet, deittemar behon (Bereshit 41:21) vattavona el kirbenna velo noda ki vau el kirbenna umarehen ra, chashuch kaasher battechilla. dechol kach chashocha daananin dilhon, dela yachlin nehorin leanhara lehon, uvegin da velo noda ki vau el kirbena. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Tehillim 68:31) gear chayyat kane adat abbirim beegle ammim. gear chayyat, da chayya deitachad bah esav. kane: tanenan, divyoma denasav shelomo malka bat paro, ba gavriel, naatz kane beyamma rabba, vealeh itbene karta deromi. may kane. da dechura dehay chayya

Raya mehemna ribbi shimon patach veamar, gear chayyat kane adat abbirim beegle ammim. gear chayyat kane, da kane deitachad beh esav, deihi karta deromi rabbeta, denaatz gavriel kane beyamma rabba, uvanu aleha kerach gadol deromi. kane dechametz. vechad yite purekana leyisrael, yitbar leh.
1534: Bisha, deit leh sitra zeera beachaduta dikdushsha. veda ihu kane, denaitz beyamma rabba. uvegin kach ihi shalta al alma, veal shuletanu da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 19:6) kane vasuf kamelu. kane, shuletanuta verosh lechol malkevavn. tu kane, dezammin kudesha berich hu letavra leh kekane da.

Ta chaze, bemitzrayim ihi shalta, uminah nafku kama shultanin lezinnayyhu, vecholla beraza dechametz, kevan detavar lah kudesha berich hu, appik chametz veail matztza. bema. bechuta zeera mikkolla, tavar 8 chametz, veitavid matztza. innun atvavn. ella detavar 8 dehay chayya, deikre chametz. veal da ikre chayyat kane, denoach leatbera kekane da. bema ittebar. bechuta zeera kenima, tavar 8 veitavar meetanah, vahava matztza. veal da ketiv, gear chayyat kane, gaar bah kudesha berich hu, veattebar 8 chametz, veitavid Adonai. (sefer acher veitavar 8 chametz veitavid)

Vezammin kudesha berich hu. letavra leh lehahu kane, kegavvna da, yatbar ragleh dek mikane, veyishtear hinne. (Yeshayahu 40:10) hinne Adonai elohim bechazak yavo uzeroo moshla lo hinne secharo itto ufeullato lefanav. may ufeullato. da poal dehahi 100 (sefer acher paavaleh dehahu chametz) deyatbar lah, veihi peula lefanav, ihu yabar ragleh, vihe hinne (Yeshayahu 41:27) rishon letziyyon hinne hinnam vegomer.
Hada hu dichtiv gear chayyat kane adat. umitabbar miyyad chametz mealma. machmetztzet dileh romi. veyitgalyya matztza bealma, deihi be makdesha devayit rishon uvayit sheni.

Amar butztzina kaddisha (sefer acher raya mehemana), deinnun lokovel bat ayin yamin, uvat ayin semol. veinnun lokovel (lechem mishna) romi rabbati, romi zeera. lokovel teren ananin, dimkasseyayn al bat ena yemina usemala. veinnun lokovel seor vechametz. vead deillen yitbaarun mealma bal yirae uval yimmatztze chad minnayyhu, bayit rishon vesheni la yitgalyayn bealma.

Veasvavta daanana ena, deachashich levat ena yamin usemol, ma yehe asvavta dilhon. mara deegla. vehayeynu (Yeshayahu 27:10) sham yire egel vesham yirbatz. sham yire egel, da mashiach ben yosef, deittemar beh (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro hadar lo. vesham yirbatz, da mashiach ben david. chad abar romi rabbati. vechad abar romi zeerta. vegavriel demichael lokkovlayyhu innun.

Uvegin da 8, deihu chuta zeera, tavar lah, veyeul Adonai beatraha. divkadmeta kane vasuf kamelu. kane shultanuta deromi, vasuf lechol malchin, deatid kudesha berich hu letavra leh. gear chayyat kane, gear chayya bisha, 8 min chametz, veatbar ragleh min machmetztzet, deittemar bah (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavt. veod gear chayyat kane, yatbar regel kof min kane, veyishtear hinne. miyyad hinne Adonai elohim bechazak yavo, (Yeshayahu 41:27) rishon letztziyyon hinne hinnam veliyrushalam mevasser etten. hinne: 60 batar elef umatan.

Veamar (Shemot 49) butztzina kaddisha, (Bereshit 46:27) kol hannefesh levet yaakov shishshim vashesh. shishshim, leataruta demashiach rishon. vashesh, leataruta demashiach sheni. ishtaaru 6 shanim lev, lekayyem behu, (Vayikra 25:3) shesh shanim tizra sadecha veshesh shanim tizmor karmecha veasafta et tevuatah, deittemar (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato.

Behahu zimna tzarich lesaddera menora (sefer acher patora) lisudata demalka, umashkena umenarta vaarona umadbecha, vechol mine shimmusha deveta demalka. velav batar patora azlenan delav ovada dekudesha berich hu, dela azlenan ella batar patora deihu ovade yedoy dekudesha berich hu, deihu shechinteh. mishkan dileh, patora dileh, menarta dileh, arona dileh, madbecha dileh, ihi kelila mikkol mane shimmusha lemalka illaa.

1539: Ufarchat leella, venachtat. vechol innun benin ditchot gadpe immehon, kevan deshame hahu tziftzufa deachathon, ulechishu dehahu kala, miyyad nafke mittechot gadfaha deimmehon, ufarche legabbe hahu tzippora, veyisrael natle lon, veachde behu. veilmale hahu tzippora deka achde bekadmita, innun la parche legabbayyhu lealmin, vela yachlin leachada behu.

Umeshallechin lehahu dirvia alayyhu veazlat. begin deha min rekia sheviaa uleella, bamchusse mimmach al tidrosh. shalach leh, dela tichol leadbeka veal da ketiv, (Devarim 22:7) shallech teshallach vegomer.

Mikra kodesh, da keria vetziftzufa, deavdin lehahu tzippara kaddisha bekadmita. vechevan deachdin bah shear yomin, ikrun mikrae koddesh. hay tzippara ikre kodesh, dichtiv, ki kodesh hi lachem. uvegin deihi kodesh, ihi kara lechulehu veatyayn legabbah. uvegin kach ikrun mikrae kodesh.

Ihi kara, veyisrael metzaftzefan bahadah, ukeraan uf hachi. veal da innun atyayn legabbayyhu, veachde behu. begin kach (Vayikra 23:4) elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh asher tikreu otam. mikrae kodesh, betziftzufa dillehon, uvehahu tzippara kaddisha kodesh, dekara lon.

Shin ditlat rashin 300. veshyn dearba rashin ditfilin. veinnun lokovel 7 birchan dikriat shema, deinnun bashshachar mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha, uvaerev mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha. levatar, kahana rabba baavoda, dimshammesh bechanfe mitztzeva, paamonim verimmonim, innun kishrin vechuleyayn vetztzitz tefillin, mittamman veelach (Shemot 30:1) veasita mizbeach miktar ketoret.

Patach raya mehemana, (davar acher rabbi shimon) veamar, ketiv befarsheta da, vehikravtem ishshe ola laAdonai. veokmuha, deola laishshim. uvegin kach samach ola leishshe. veod okmuha, delet ola atya ella al hirhur hallev.

Vadday, kol karbenin la atyayn, ella lechappera. kol karbena vekarbena, al kol evarin debar nash, kefum hahu chet dehahu ever. al tippin democha, (Shemot 12:39) ugot matztzot ki lo chametz. i zarik tippin kadmain, kodem deachmitztzu, baatar delav dileh. veal illen deachmitztzu, vezarik lon baatar dela itztzetrich, tzarich leayytaa alayyhu lechem chametz, veinnun lachmi toda hachi havo, minnehon chametz, uminnehon matztza. parim missitra dedina, kevasim veelim veattudim veizzim. begin deinnun anpe deshor, kullehu shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichle sharet batztzafon.

Shechita vekabbala uzerika kullam batztzafon. levassema middat haddin, deate levet din missitra digvura. bet din haggadol missitra digvura, detamman bina. bet din hakkatan, missitra demalchut. vechol innun shofche damim lemitztzeva, innun missitra digvura.

Uma deokmuha, olat shabbat beshabbato vela beshabbat ochora, begin deavar yomo batel karbano. dekarban docha shabbat, veadlik esh beshabbat, begin deihu eshsha kedosha. dechol esh dekarbenin ihu kodesh, veshabbat kodesh, achidan da beda.

Aval esh dechol, asir leachada leh bakkodesh, uvegin da mane lon leyisrael, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. dehay ihu kilayim detov vara. uveshabbat deshalta ilana dechayyi, delet beh taarovet, (asir laabaaraa beh dachevaleyn, dehay esh dachevaleyn datevameah velo dachevaleyn detohora) vechulin detohora asir learva beesh dikdushsha. kol shekken chulin detumea, deasir learva lon bikdushsha. uf hachi kol karbenin, itkeriu besar kodesh. vechol karbenin dechol min, it behon chulin detohora, veit behon
1540: Veraza, deit hefresh ben kodesh lekodesh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 26:33) vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim. uf hacha eshshot dekarbenin, lav innun shavin. deesh shel gavoah mekuddash meesh dekodesh diltatta. deitkere esh atze hakkodesh, o esh besar hakkodesh. veeshsha dekudesha, it beh haferasha leven esh hedyot. af al gav deokmuha aleh, demitzva lehavi min hahedyot, af al gav deit esh dekudesha, dechol chad tzarich leatreh. umatla imtilu yisrael kadmae lehay raza yisrael.

(Nusach acher yisrael ametaylav lehay. deha yisrael bichlal) itkeriu melachim kema deokmuha, kol yisrael bene melachim. aval kad havo alin leve makdesha, kol chad sharyay beatreh, kaddeka yaut leh. uf hachi kol karbenin lav innun shavin, deaf al gav divchullehu ketiv karban laAdonai, ihu palig kolla kol chad vechad kaddeka yaut. veraza da, ishtemoda befare hechag, dahavo kerivin lon yisrael kodam Adonai.

Amar butzina kaddisha, kum raya mehemana mishshenatach, deant vaavahan yeshene afar itkerun, dead kean havitun mishtaddelin beorayyta, beinnun yeshenim bamishna, deittemar behon al haaretz tishan. uveyom habbikkurim behakerivchem mincha chadasha laAdonai. attun innun (bene) bikkurim dishchinta, uveovadin dilchon, ihi itchaddeshat bitzlotin daavahan bechol yoma. deokmuha mare matnitin, tefillot keneged avot tiknum. uvekriat shema deamar raya mehemana shema yisrael, veokmuha kol hakkore keriat shema bechol yom, keillu hu mekayyem (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam valayla.

Vday bitzlotin dilchon, bikriat shema dilchon, shechinta ihi itchaddeshat kammeh dekudesha berich hu. uvegin da, vehikravtem mincha chadasha laAdonai. bitzlotin deinnun baatar dekarbenin. bean karbenin ditzlotin ihi mitchadeshet. beshavuotechem. dehayynu shavuot, deveh mattan tora, veitkere chamishshim yom laomer. uveh shiva shavuot, missitra dehahu deittemar beh, (Tehillim 119:164) sheva bayom hillalticha, veihi malchut kalla. kelila mishsheva sefiran, kelila babbina, deihi itpashshetat baAdonai sefiran lechamshin.

Yesod kol, kalul meillen chamshin. kalla: kol Adonai. kelila mechamishim, kullehu nivlaim bego chamishshim, chachma deihi, 10 illaa, muvelaat bego chamshin. Adonai zimnin eser. Adonai bina. 10 chachma. eser zimnin Adonai hayeynu chamshin uvechusheban kol. uvechusheban yam. veihu yam hattora. mekora dileh keter, delet leh sof. shear sefiran, itkeriu al shemah shivat yamim. umalchut yam suf, sof dechol yamim.

Uvegin da deinnun chamshin, sheva shavuot, minchatam shelosha esronim, ushene esronim. chamesh, deinnun chamesh zimnin eser. hada hu dichtiv, uminchatam solet belula vashshemen shelosha esronim lappar haechad ushene esronim laayil haechad issaron issaron lakkeves haechad leshivat hakkevasim. veshivat hakkevasim, lokovel (Vayikra 23:15) sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena. kol chad im shit yomin dileh.

(Bamidbar 29:1) uveasor lachodesh hashshevii, deihu tishre. mikra kodesh yihye lachem, da yom hakkippurim. deihu asiri 10, kalil measeret yeme teshuva. vetakkinu beh Adonai tzelotin, lechabbera lah im Adonai. (may mikra kodesh. yihye lachem da yom hakkippurim deihi asiri 10, kalil meusseret yeme teshuva. vetakkinu beh Adonai tzelotin, lechabbera im Adonai) may mikra kodesh. leafresha leh mishshear yomin, deit behu pulechana dechol. uvegin da, kol melechet avoda lo taasu.

Deyomin deit behon melechet chol, innun missitra deetz haddaat tov vara. deithappach mimmatte lenachash, uminachash lematte. lechol chad kefum ovadoy, veda metatron matte, nachash, samael. aval behay yoma deihu yom hakkippurim deitkere kodesh, shalta ilana dechayye, dela ishtetaf immeh satan ufega ra. umissitreh (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra. uvegin da, beh nayychin avdin beilana dechayye, (nusach acher vaashatetapen gabbeh) uveh nafkan lecherut, beh nafke mishulshelehon.

Innun deit alayyhu gezar din, beneder uvishvua, uvegin da takkinu lememar beh, kol nidre veesare vechulei, kulehon yehon shevitin ushevikin la sheririn vela kayyaymin. uvegin da neder daydod, deihu tiferet. ushevua daadonay, deihu malchut. deavdu al galuta dilhon, bechachma uvina yehon shevikin ushevitin la sheririn vela kayyaymin, (Bamidbar 15:26) venislach lechol adat bene yisrael. dechesed ihu mayim. gevura esh. tiferet avvir. uvegin da ukemuha mare matnitin, hetter nedarim porchim baavir.

Uvegin dishvua mimmalchut, deihi letatta minneh. okmuha, nedarim al gabbe shevuot olim. veod okmuha, kol hannishba keillu nishba bammelech atzmo. vechol hannoder keillu noder bechayye hammelech. hammelech atzmo, adonay. chayye hammelech, Adonai. uvegin da (Bamidbar 30:3) ki yiddor neder laydod.

1541: Hammelech, chachma. hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. kol hannoder baAdonai, deihu tiferet. keillu noder bachachma, deihu yod hei vav hei, chayye hammelech. vechol hannishba badonay, keillu nishba bammelech atzmo. atzmo da imma illaa, keillu nishba bah, deihi (Shemot 24:10) etzem hashshamayim latohar. missitra dechesed, (Bereshit 2:23) etzem meatzamay. uvasar mibbesari, missitra digvura, da malchut. uvechachma deihi chayye tiferet, ihu salik leitkere adam, hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya 44) ketiferet adam.

Veittemar beyom hakkippurim. (Vayikra 16:31) veinnitem et nafshotechem. uveasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze teannu et nafshotechem. takkinu beh Adonai innuyim, begin detitlabben Adonai zeera baAdonai illaa, deihu Adonai tzelotin. lekayyem beyisrael, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu. vehay ihu raza delashon shel zehorit, begin dechol chovin deyisrael matun legabbe malchut. uteshuva deihi bina, melabbenet lon. begin deittemar bah, (Vayikra 16:16) hashshochen ittam betoch tumeotam. ved bigde lavan, ved bigde zahav lemilbash, yeahdonahy.

Vetakkinu litkoa shofar beyom hakkippurim, lesalleka kol deihu 6, lecherut. deittemar bah, (yeshaya 63) bechol tzaratam lo tzar, be, uvev, kere uchetiv. vaavodat yom hakkippurim ihi baarichut, veihi kelila mittelat dargin, bemachashava dibbur umaase.

(Vayikra 23:34) bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii vegomer, deihi tishre, mikra kodesh yihye lachem kol melechet avoda lo taasu vechaggotem oto chag laAdonai shivat yamim vegomer. bachamishsha asar, missitra deyah. vechaggotem oto, da ot 6, ammuda deemtzaita. (11 chesed gevura) shivat yamim, missitra devat sheva, deihi malchut. avahan, veraya mehemana, veaharon, david ushelomo, ha innun sheva, lokovel sheva sefiran. ana baena letakkena lechon sukka, deihi imma illaa, lesakkecha alayyhu, keimma al benin.

Uvegin 7 sefiran amar kera, (Vayikra 23:43) ki vassukkot hoshavti et bene yisrael, bemafkanutehon meara demitzrayim, bez anane kavod. sukka (it bata 6, basukkot chaser 6, deittemar bah bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim, ihi ema aval socha) beat 6, ihu beraza (dateybeyn) ditren benin, yedod adonay. vehachi salik sukka bechusheban yeahdonahy. teren keruvim, dehem (Shemot 25:20) sochchim bechanfehem al hakkapporet ufenehem ish el achiv.

Veit asra tefachim bakkeruvim mittatta leella, meraglehon ad reshehon, umereshehon vead raglehon, vesharyayn al tefach deihu 10. veasra asra meella letatta, umittatta leella, hayeynu yod. uvegin kach, shiura dessukka amru rabbanan, lo pachut measara, velo lemala meesrim. sukka haasuya kechivshan missitra deimma, alah ittemar, (Shemot 19:18) vehar sinay ashan kullo mippene asher yarad alav Adonai baesh vayyaal ashano keeshen hakkivshan. (veukemuha may 1 vehachayyot ratzo veshuv, keor hayyotze mippi hakkivshan) vecholla chad.

(Yeshayahu 4:6) vesukka tihye letzel yomam, dischach baenan. usechach itavid latzel. deittemar beh, (Tehillim 91:1) betzel shadday yitlonan. velo betzel sukkat hedyot, deagin al gufa mishimmesha. ella tzel leaggana al nishmeta. (Shir HaShirim 2:3) betzillo chimmadti veyashavti. (Eicha 4:20) asher amarnu betzillo nichye vaggoyim. tzel im 40, ihi tzelem. deittemar beh, (Tehillim 39:7) ach betzelem yithallech ish. 40 setuma it lah arbaa defanot.

Uma deukemuha shetayim kehilchatan ushelishit afillu tefach. uleman deamar shelosha kehilchatan ureviit afillu tefach. veinnun begin da, teren, telat, arba, ha tesha, tefach ihi ashiraa, leashlema kol chesron. uvegin da, shiur sukka lo pachut meeser, deihi malchut, ashiraa dechol dargin. vela lemala meesrin, deihi 20, keter elyon, dela shalta beh ena. kavod illaa, aleh amar moshe, (Shemot 33:18) hareeni na et kevodecha. veativ leh kudesha berich hu, lo tuchal lirot et panay. velet kavod, bela 20.

Uvegin da sieru mare matnitin lokovlayyhu, sukka haasuya kemavoy, missitra deat 2, kemin 44, missitra deat 3. kemin tzerif, missitra deat 4. vesheva atvavn innun, begin da kfrt. 20, kivshan. 2, bureganin. ushear sukkot. vechullehu remize legabbe mare matnitin. velet learacha behon.

Veinnun lokovlayyhu shiva kochve lechet, veinnun dechar venukeba. uvegin da itkeriu 7 kefulot. kegon shiva shargin dimnarta, deittemar bah (Tehillim 119:164) sheva bayom hillalticha. hachi (Zecharya 4:2) shiva veshiva mutzakot. hachi shiva sefiran kefulot. veshiva yome bereshit letatta, shiva leella, (Kohelet 1:9) en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh.

Lulav da tzaddik. dedame lechut hashshidra, deveh 18 chuleyayn, lokovel 18 ninuin delulav. veinnun lokovel 18 birchan ditzlota. lokovel shemone asar azkarot, (Tehillim 29:1) dehavu laAdonai bene elim. lokovel shemone asar azkarot dikriat shema. veninua leshit sitrin, bechusheban 6. telat ninuin bechol sitra, innun 18.
1542: Hadassin, gedulla gevura tiferet. vedamyayn litlat gevavne ena. 2 badde aravot, netzach vehod. vedamyayn litren sifvavn. lulav, yesod, dome lashshidra. deveh kiyyum dechol garmin. vealeh amar david, (Tehillim 35:10) kol atzmotay tomarnna Adonai mi chamocha. etrog, malchut. dome lelibba. deveh hirhurin.

Veninuin dehalel, innun meshuttafin beninuin dintilat lulav, veinnun 18 beana. 18 18, behodu techilla vasof. 18 dintilat lulav, hare amud bet. uvegin da lulav bechusheban 68, ved minin delulav, ha chesed, deroa yemina. uvegin da takkinu lulav bayyamin, lesitra dechesed. etrog lesitra digvura, lismala libba. uvegin da etrog haddome lallev, takkinu lemehevi beyad semol. kema deukemuha, lulav bayyamin, veetrog bismolo. innun lokovel zachor veshamor. uman natil tarvavyyhu. ammuda deemtzaita. lulav bimineh, veetrog bismaleh.

Atu avahan, veraya mehemana, veaharon vedavid ushelomo, uvarichu leh, veamru leh, ant butzina kaddisha, vechavrayyay dilach deinnun shit, lokovel innun 7. veant butzina kaddisha ner maaravi beemtza, dechol shit nerot nehirin minach. bechol chad ittemar beh, (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam. veraya mehemana nahir bach, veant bechavrayyay dilach, vecholla chad, bela piruda kelal. umittamman veilach mitpashshetin anfin lechol mare chachmeta, ashlim millin dachavura kadmaa dilach leattera lon.

Patach butzina kaddisha veamar, bechibbura kadmaa ittemar (Shir HaShirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava vegomer. may buz. yoma tinyayna, veyoma shetitaa, veyoma sheviaa desukkot. divhon havo menassechim mayim veyayin.

Desheva yomin desukkot, behon hayu makrivin yisrael shivim parim, lechappera al shivin memanan, begin dela yishtear alma charuv minnayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, uvachamishsha asar yom vehikravtem ola ishshe lereach nichoach laAdonai parim bene vakar shelosha asar temimim. uvayyom hashsheni parim 12. uvayyom hashshelishi 11. uvayyom harvii asara. uvayyom hachamishi parim tisha. uvayyom hashshishshi parim shemone. uvayyom hashshevii shiva. vechullehu shivin. uvechol yoma havo chaserim. amay chaserim.

Ella hacha ka ramiz, (Bereshit 8:4) vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashshevii. uma hatam beyme tofana, (Bereshit 8:4) vehammayim halchu haloch vechasor. uf hachi betishre, deihu yarcha sheviaa, deveh kama pikudin, rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, sukka velulav etrog, minin delulav shofar. shechinta illaa sharyay al yisrael, deihi teshuva, sukka. etrog, vekudesha berich hu deihu lulav. miyyad vehammayim hayu haloch vechasor, mitmaatin chovin deyisrael, uf hachi mitmaatin memanan deinnun malache chabbala, dimmanan alayyhu, dedamyayn leme tofana. kema deokmuha, asa avera achat kana lo kategor echad. behahu zimna demitmaatin chovin, mitmaatin parim dilhon, mitmaatin memanan de umin, mitmaatin 70 umin, mitmaet tuva dilhon.

Tevat noach, mane kudesha berich hu, leaala immeh (Bereshit 7:3) shenayim shenayim shiva shiva zachar unekeva, lekarbana, leaggana al noach, veal kol innun dealin immeh latteva. uf hachi illen dimnatterin chaggin uzemanin, deinnun yamim tovim, shenayim shenayim shiva shiva, shenayim shenayim teren yomin derosh hashshana, uteren yomin deshavuot, uvegin deinnun teren minnayyhu besafek, ha it shene yeme happurim beatrayyhu. shiva shiva, 7 yomin defesach, 7 yomin desukkot. noach lokovel yom hashshabbat, vehay ihu mikkol hachay.

Sukka ka aginat alayyhu deyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:6) vesukka tihye letzel yomam mechorev. sukka ka aginat. ma tevat noach leaggana, uf hachi sukka leaggana. (tikkunin 2 amud alef) veod mikkol hachay, 18 birchan ditzlota, meinnun 9 9, birchata deminin bah ishtelimu 10 sefiran meella letatta, umittatta leella. veihu lokovel noach.

Veod mikkol hachay, shechinta aginat al illen denatrin 10, ot shabbat bitchuma dileh, deihu 8 alafim, teren alfin lechol tzad. veod, mikkol hachay, illen denatrin 10 ot berit, deihu bech yomin, deittemar alayyhu, (Vayikra 12:3) uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar arlato. veod, mikkol hachay, illen denatrin ot 10, tefillin bitmanyay parashyayn.

Shechinta deihi sukka, aginat alayyhu, uferishat gadpaa alayyhu, keimma al benin, uvegin da takkinu levarcha, happores sukkat shalom alenu. uvegin da beyarcha sheviaa, deveh kol pikkudin illen, (Shir HaShirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava. am yisrael baavuhon shebbashshamayim. velet mayim rabbim, ella kol umin umemanan dilhon. im yitten ish, deihu samael, kol ma deit leh bealma den, begin
1543: Deyishtattaf beillen pikudin im yisrael, boz yavuzu lo.

Uvayyom hashshemini atzeret par echad ayil echad, ha ukemuha mare matnitin, lemalka dezammin ushepizin, levatar deshalach lon, amar leillen bene beta dileh, ana veattun navid seuda ketanna. umay atzeret. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 9:17) ze yatzor beammi, velet etzer ella malchut. missitra dishchinta illaa, avid seudata ravreva, umissitra demalchuta, seudata zeera. venohagin lemebad yisrael immah chedva, veitkeriat simchat tora. umeatteran lesefer tora becheter dileh, remez sefer tora letiferet, shechinta ateret tiferet.
Amar ribbi elazar, abba, amay missitra deimma illaa, zammin lechol memanan dechol umin, umissitra dishchinta tattaa, la zammin ella leuma yechida, lokovel par yechida.

Amar leh beri, shappir sheilat. begin demalchut ihi remiza livratta, deihi tzenua bevet aviha veimmah. veihi arusa vela nesua. lav orach ara, lemechal im oshpizin. aval imma dehi nesua, orach ara ihu (lemechal im orchi) batar dimazmmin balah oshpize, lemechal al patora im balah. vei innun ushepizin nuchrain, la achle immehon, la abba, vela imma, vechol shekken beratta. uvegin kach bisudata deshivin memanan, la ishtetaf lemechal immehon, chad min mare malka, begin deinnun nucherain. amar leh vday kean ityayshshevat milla belibbai, al bureyeh.

Olat tamid, da shechinta, dislikat leella behahu darga, deittemar bah erev vavoker bechol yom tamid, veomrim paamayim shema yisrael. veihi selikat beammuda deemtzaita, deihu tadir immah bela piruda kelal.

Ulean selikat. leatar deitgezarat mittamman, deihu en sof, veihu gavoah mikkol sefiran. uvegin da okmuha. ola kulah laggavoah salleka. vechad ihi selikat, achidan bah kol sefiran, veinnun sallekin immah. umay seliku dilah. lereach nichoach, lemehav recha tava kodam Adonai, ulevatar ittemar bah, (Vayikra 9:22) vayyered measot hachattat vehaola. nachtat malya kappara mikkol chovin deyisrael.

Veha seliku dilah ihu, beammuda deemtzaita. uf hachi nechitu dilah ihu beh, vechol chayyaylin dilah, uvegin da ikre sullam, deveh kol havavyayn (nusach acher chinnuyin) sallekin venachtin, deinnun talyayn min yedod. uvegin da, kol karbenin veillavavn innun laydod. veitkeriat karban, al shem deitkerivu bah kol kinnuyin laydod.

Uvegin da ittemar alah, (Bamidbar 7:19) karbano kaarat kesef achat. let darga deitkeriv legabbe yedod, pachut minnah. velet tzelota ufikkuda mikkol pikudin deorayyta, vechol karbenin veillavavn, deinnun levar minnah. bechol dargin disfiran la mitkabbelan kodam yedod, levar minnah. uvegin da ittemar alah, (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. uvegin da amar navi, (Yirmeyahu 9:23) ki im bezot yithallel hammithallel.

Ihi shelamim, shelimu dishma daydod, bechol darga vedarga. ihi Adonai. adonay. 10 daydod. ihi Adonai min elohim. ihi Adonai min ehye. 10 min shadday. sof dechol havaya vechinnuy. uvegin da ittemar bah, (Kohelet 12:13) sof davar hakkol nishma et haelohim yere veet mitzvotav shemor. ihi sof meeser sefiran, yam suf. shelimu deillain vetattain. ihu tara leaala lechol chachmeta, lechol kinnuy vahavaya, uleaala bechol sefira usefira, yedia decholla. ufachut minah, let reshu leshum birya, leashgacha leshum yedia baolam. alah ittemar, (Tehillim 118:20) ze hashshaar laAdonai tzaddikim yavou vo.
