Uvegin da, kol shemahan, innun kinnuyin dileh. al shem ovadin dileh. kegavvna da, bara nishmeta, bediyyukena dileh, deitkeriat al shem peulot dilah, bechol ever veever degufa, deitkere alma zeera. kegavvna demare alma, itnehig bechol biryayn. uvechol dara, kefum ovadoy. kach nishmeta, kefum ovadoy dechol ever veever. hahu ever deavid beh pikkuda, itkere nishmeta, legabbe chemla vechisda chinna verachame. uvehahu ever deavid beh avera, itkere nishmeta legabbe, dina vechema vachaas. aval levar min gufa, leman tehe chemla, o achzariut.

Uf hachi mare alma, kodem devara alma, uvara biryayn dileh, leman itkere rachum vechannun o dayyayn. ella kol shemahan dileh, innun kinnuyin, vela itkere behon, ella al shem biryayn dealma, uvegin da, kad mare dara innun tavin, ihu itkere legabbayyhu, Adonai bemidat rachamim. vechad mare dara innun chayyayvin, itkere adonay bemidat haddin. lechol dara, ulechol bar nash, kefum midda dileh. aval lav deit leh midda vela shem yedia.

Kegavvna disfiran, dechol sefira it lah shem yedia, umidda, ugevul, utechum. uveillen shemahan mare alma ihu itpeshshat, veamlich behon, veitkere behon, veitkasse behon, vedar behon, kenishmeta legabbe evarim degufa. uma ribbon almin, let leh shem yedia vela atar yedia, ella bechol sitra shuletanuteh. uf hachi let lah lenishmeta shem yedia, vela atar yedia, bechol gufa ella bechol setar shuletanuteh, velet ever panuy minnah.

Uvegin da, let lerashshema lah bechad atar, dei lav ha chaser shuletanuta bishar evarim. vela leitkere lah bishma chad, o bitren, o beg. lememar deihi chachma mibbina, veit lah daat, vela yattir. dei avid hachi, ha chaser lah mishshear dargin.

Kol shekken lemare alma, delet lerashma leh baatar yedia, o leitkere leh bishmahan, o leshannaa leh behon, o (sefer acher lashelashea) leshalletaa leh kegon darga demerkavta, deittemar bah kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu, dechol dargin dechol markevot dileh, innun meshullashim, kegon haavot hen hen hammerkava, deinnun demut arye shor nesher, deinnun merkava leadam. deittemar aleh, (Yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam. umissitra denukeba, innun shaltin al adam, venukeba ihi merkava legabbayyhu. uvegin da ittemar alah, kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu.

Veof hachi atvavn, deinnun anpin dechevan, meshullashin, kegavvna da: 20. 21. 21. Adonai reviaa, kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. ihi shelamim dechullehu, leashlema bechullehu shem Adonai. aval lemareh decholla, let leshallesha beh bishmahan, vela beatvavn, ella ihu itkere bechol shemahan, velet leh shem yedia. vechol shem veshem ashid aleh, deihu adon kol almin. ashid aleh adonay.

Velet deyadin deit bar nash, deyarit 3 mea veeser almin, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh. kefum darga dileh, deitkere yesh meayin. veda chachma illaa. veit bar nash dela yarit ella alma chad, kefum darga dileh, kema deokmuha, kol tzaddik vetzaddik yesh lo olam bifne atzmo. vehachi yarit almin kol bar nash miyisrael, kefum darga dileh leella. aval lemare alma, let lerashma leh almin bechusheban, ella adon kol almin, veadonay ka sahid aleh.

Uf hachi Adonai, minneh talyay kol havayayn, veihu vechol havayayn dileh, sahadin al mare alma, deihu hava kodem kol havayayn. veihu betoch kol havaya. veihu leachar kol havaya. veda raza, desahadin havayayn aleh, haya, ho, veyihye.

1546: Chashivayn uchemitzbeye abbed bechel shemaya vegomer. elohim, said al elahut dileh, deihu elohim vilohe haelohim, veihu eloah al kolla, velet eloah aleh. tzevaot, sahid aleh kedichtiv, uchemitzbeyeh avid bechel shemaya. shadday, sahid aleh, dechad ihu amar leolam day amad bitchumeh, vela itpeshshat yattir. veuf lemayya verucha veeshsha.

Uveratta ihi tefilla shel yad, keha. 10 kesher dileh. Adonai illaa imma, tefillin deresha al rosh tiferet. tefillin dileh, keseder Adonai, deihu kaddesh li. vehaya ki yeviacha. shema. vehaya im shamoa. aval bealma deate, havayot beemtza, deinnun Adonai Adonai. uvegin da amar hanavi, (Yirmeyahu 9:23) bezot yithallel hamithallel hasekel veyadoa oti ki ani Adonai. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, deit beresha atar, leanacha tere zuge ditfille. veda zache litren pikudin, deokmuha alayyhu, lo kol adam zoche lishte shulechanot.

10 Chachma. Adonai bina. 6 ammuda deemtzaita. Adonai malchut kaddisha. resha deitattar bearba atvavn, da keter rihata deresha deaschar lon, vechasse lon. ahava chesed keriat shema, dishkila leorayyta, deityeyhivat mimina. tefillin oz, missemala digvura. ammuda deemtzaita, kalil kolla, kanfe demitzva, netzach vehod, techelet velavan. mezuza rashim shadday, tzaddik. ushechinta tara dimzuza, ze hashshaar laydod.

Veod 300 telat retzuot. 4 kesher shel tefillin meachoroy. 10 kesher ditfillin deyad. uvegin da shadday millevar, Adonai millego, deihi 4 parshiyayn. 8 rashin remez 34 batte ditfillin, shadday ot dileh ole 314.

Veod. 10 chachma kaddesh li. Adonai bina, vehaya ki yeviacha. 6 shema, shit tevin, remiza leshit sefiran, shit anfin deilana, dechalal lon tiferet. Adonai vehaya im shamoa malchut. illen innun deresha, deihu keter, 20, (Shmuel 1 2:2) en kadosh kaAdonai ki en biltecha.

Shadday, ramiz retzue uvate vekishre ditfillin millevar. uf hachi bammezuza, Adonai millego, shadday millevar, dearba rashin im 4 ramiz 34 batte ulekesher tefillin meachor 4 kefula uf hachi 300 kefula, 10 kesher deyad keha deihu beta chamishaa 4 (sefer acher 10) deshadday ihu mocha doukemuah aleh bammakom shemocho shel tinok rofes bo, veda tinok yonek mishshede immo shadday.

Tefillin demare alma, keter. umay nihu keter demare alma. Adonai. deihu: 10 chachma. Adonai bina. 6 tiferet. kalil shit sefirayn. Adonai malchut. uvegin da (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael (Devarim 4:7) ki mi goy gadol asher lo elohim kerovim elav, kaAdonai elohenu bechol karenu elav. arba kerae, kullehu reshimin bech, raza deat 20: 10 10. deihi 10 10 min yeahdonahy, (Bamidbar 7:86) asara asara hakkaf beshekel hakkodesh, k min keter, kelila meeser sefiran, kelilan meella letatta, umeeser sefiran mittatta leella.

Veillen innun, (Tehillim 148:4) vehammayim asher meal hashshamayim, mayim elyonim zecharim, mayim tachtonim nekevot. vealayyhu amar ribbi akiva letalmidav, keshettaggiu leavne shayish tahor, al tomru mayim mayim, shema tistakkenu benafshechem. delav innun mayim kemashmaan. ella ihu or novea. uvegin da, iddemu lemayim novim. vehay nehora let leh pesak, velo kitzutz, ufirud. uvegin deinnun mikketer, itkerian sheen lahem sof, decheter en sof itkere. 1547: (Bamidbar 28:27) vehikravtem ola lereach nichoach laAdonai. ta chaze, befesach ketiv, vehikravtem ishshe ola laAdonai. vehacha la ketiv ishshe, (deha beyoma da ishsha lo ketiv beh) ella vehikravtem ola. may tama. yoma da, yoma deayylat kalla lechuppa ihu. veyisrael manu yomin dedachyu. yomin veshavuin, veitkelilu vealu beyomin dedachyu. vehi nafkat mikkol sitra bisha, venatrat yome dachyu kaddeka chaze. veraza da, malka taam betula taim. begin kach la ketiv beh ishshe, deha achara la kariv lemashkena, veha itrechak mittamman. veal da ishshim lav hacha, velav itzterichu lehacha, veyisrael merachakan innun min sitra bisha. (vamenan yomin dadekayv, yomin vashebaveayn, veitkalylu vealu beyomin dadekayv). amar ribbi abba, adayin tzerichin anan lefitcha da lemiftach.

Amar rabbi shimon, arimit yeday betzallu leman devara alma, veraza da, ashkechan besifre kadmae, ishshim innun beemtzaita, veatyayn besitra da uvesitra da, idabbeku beilana dedaat tov vara, idabbekan bera, veidabbekan betov. uvegin kach, bishar yomin ketiv behu ishshe ola. aval behane yoma, deilana dechayye kayyeyma, vela achara, let anan tzerichin leishshe, vela itzterich lemehevi tamman. veyoma da, yoma deilana dechayye ihu, vela dedaat tov vara. uvegin da, vehikravtem ola lereach nichoach laAdonai, vela ishe laAdonai ola. veola, lashon (nusach acher leshem) ole, kema deittemar, veha ittearna mille defarim bene bakar, vechol hahu karban.

(Bamidbar 29:1) uvachodesh hashshevii, kema deittemar, yoma derosh hashshana, dina dechol alma, dina takkifa, vedina rafya. vaasitem ola, vehikravtem mibbae leh, kishar kol yomin, may vaasitem. ella beyoma da, (Bereshit 27:4) vaase li matammim ketiv. kama matammim vetavshilim avdu yisrael behane yome, beod dimkatrega azil lefashpesha bechovin dealma. veal da la ketiv vehikravtem, ella vaasitem ola. vela ishshe ola. vechen bechol shear yomin, (sefer acher bekarbenin) la ketiv ishshe, delet lon chulaka bechol hane yome. kol shekken behay yoma, daanan avdin matammim vetavshilim bela data desitra achara, deha yitzchak meshadder leh latzud tzeda dechovin divne alma, uleayytaa legabbeh.

Uveod deihu azil, yisrael natle eta berivka, veavdin kol innun pulechanin, kol innun tzelotin, mezammene shofar vetakin leh, begin leatteara rachame. veha okimna, (Bereshit 27:25) vayyave lo yayin vayyesht, deate (sefer acher deachal) merachok, miggo atar dechamra attika, veshate. veatim leh, vechadde. veachar kach mevarech leh bechamma birchan, veabar al chovoy. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:30) vayhi ach yatzo yatza yaakov veesav achiv ba mitztzedo, tain mikkamma toane kema deittemar, veha okimna milla.

Uvegin kach ihu yoma divava, vekarbena ihu ola. ayil echad, kema deittemar, begin elo deyitzchak. useir izzim echad lechattat, shochad lesamael lechappera (letavra) anpoy, behahu bichya deihu bache behay yoma, kevan dechame dela itavid reuteh, veha lemaggana tzad tzeda. kema deittemar. kegavvna da yoma dechippure, veha ketiv beparashat emor.

(Bamidbar 29:12) uvachamishsha asar yom vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Bereshit 8:4) vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashshevii vegomer, ta chaze, kol hane yomin, azlat imma al benayyay, begin dela yishlot sitra achara alayyhu, uvegin leshezava lon. kevan deishtezivu benaha, veha yatvin bassukkot, mitnatterin bintura. yoma kadmaa, veyoma tinyana, pakdat lon leyisrael, lemebad seudata limmemanan dishar ammin, veihi la sharya tamman. beyoma telitaa, deihu 17 lachodesh, shariat lemishre alayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashshevii beshiva asar yom lachodesh al hare ararat, turin dechol levavtin umeradin sharan begavavyyhu.

Amar ribbi elazar, yoma kadmaa dechag, la sharya alayyhu, vela yoma tinyayna, ella yoma telitaa, deosif vegara sharya alayyhu, osif atvavn, vegara karbenin. dichtiv ashte asar vegomer. vehachi itchaze lera ayin, begin deyoma kadmaa veyoma tinyayna chedva divnaha, veinnun mefalge iddaan lon. miyyoma telitaa ulehala, deihi sharya alayyhu, ma ketiv. 1548: Vehammayim hayu haloch vechasor, illen karbenin, deazlin umitmaatin. uchema deinnun mitmaatin, hachi name itmeat tuva dilhon.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar, ta chaze, miyyoma tinyayna shariu mayyay leitchazaa, kevan deshariu mayim, miyyoma telitaa ihi sharat alayyhu, veinnun mayim la havo yade bavlae (sefer acher bechola), amay reshimin hacha, deha tuva deyisrael la havi baatar demiuta, ella baatar deribbuyay. uvegin deillen mayin dirshimin hacha itmaatan, ate kera leashmeinan dichtiv, vehammayim innun diydian beyome dechag, innun dirshimin go karbenin, deinnun ture levavtin, hayu haloch vechasor tuva dilhon, unegidu deangid alayyhu, hayu haloch vechasor, uvegin deinnun mayim dilhon hu, la itchabberan atvavn, dela yitchabbar tuva dilhon, ella zeer zeer.

(Tehillim 34:11) vedorshe Adonai lo yachseru kol tov. resheh dikra, kefirim rashu veraevu, illen memanan dishar ammin. vedorshe Adonai, illen yisrael, lo yachseru kol tov, illen azlin veistallaku leella leella. uvegin kach, tuva dilhon deinnun mayim, hayu haloch vechasor. ad hachodesh haasiri. da tevet, deha keden yeme haraa havo, veitarat hahi raa veittakfat, vechalla kaddisha la anhirat miggo shimsha, keden niru rashe heharim, illen innun hare chashocha, turin dilvavtin itchazun veittekafu, veavdin bishin bealma.

Beyomin illen, ishshe behay ola, deha keden hane ishshim achle chulakehon. shivim parim illen, innun lokovel shivim memanan, deshaltu al shivin ammin. vesallekin beyoma kadmaa, venachte bechol yoma veyoma, veikrun parim menaggechin beyomin dilhon. elim, (chaser) arbesar, teren bechol yoma innun yad Adonai. yeda deshalita alayyhu tadir, bechol yoma veyoma. amrin bene shana, minyayna dilhon chetz.

Mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava, illen innun mayim, di menasseche yisrael, bechedva uvirchimu dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 12:3) usheavtem mayim besason. uneharot lo yishtefuha, illen innun nahare deafarsemona dachya, dechullehu davke umitkashshere birchimu da. im yitten ish et kol hon beto beahava boz yavuzu, da samael, beahava deyisrael, lemehevi leh chulaka bahadayyhu, beinnun mayim dirshimin hacha befarsheta, dichtiv im yitten ish et kol hon beto beahava boz yavuzu, simana deinnun mayim boz, yavuzu lo vadday, deha kullehu itchashivu legabban, cheres nishbar, delet leh tekana lealmin.

Mayim dilhon itpeligu beyomin boz, ishtaaru shear yomin, deinnun 3 4 Adonai (notarikon) chamishi revii shelishi, vesiman, (Yeshayahu 45:9) cheres et charse haadama, velet lon tikkuna bahadan, vela lealmin. vei tema boz yavuzu lo ketiv. hatam (Tehillim 22:25) ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut.

1550: Ki lo vau leezrat Adonai, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. leezrat Adonai baggibborim, beinnun shishshim gibborim kad izdemanu kerava im sisra. veda malach, raza dechol dinin vechol keravin demalka birshuteh. veal da amar, malach Adonai. veda hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 48:16) hammalach haggoel oti vegomer, veha ukemuha chavrayya. veda zemina lemeheve illaa veyakkira lezimna deate. uveda yitrabbe shema kaddisha. uveda zammin kudesha berich hu leitpara meammin avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, (Yechezkel 38:23) vehitgaddilti vehitkaddishti vegomer. azlu, ad dematu legabbeh derabbi shimon. kevan dechama lon, amar ribbi shimon, ha shechinta hacha. vadday tzerichin anan lemechzak tivu leanpe shechinta.

Patach veamar (Bereshit 29:7) hen od hayyom gadol vegomer. hay kera okmuha, dechad yisrael yittearun teshuva lekame kudesha berich hu, bizchu orayyta yetuvun leara kaddisha, veyitkanneshun min galuta. deha vadday yoma chad yehe galuta leyisrael, vela yattir. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 1:13) netanani shomema kol hayyom dava. vei la yetuvun, kudesha berich hu amar, hen od hayyom gadol lo et heasef hammikne, bela zechu uvela ovadin dechashran. aval asvata chad lechu, hasheku hatzon, ishtedalu beorayyta, deitshakyyu meme orayyta. ulechu reu, laatar denayycha laatar tava vechissufa deachasantechon.

Davar acher hen od hayyom gadol, da hu yom deikre (Yeshayahu 22:5) yom mehuma umevusa umevucha, di behahu yom itchariv be makdesha, venaflu yisrael begaluta. uvegin ovadin bishin, hahu yoma itmeshach veitrebe, hada hu dichtiv hen od hayyom gadol lo et heasef hammikne, begin deinnun mashchin leh lehahu yoma. hasheku hatztzon, kema deittemar bemille deorayyta, deha bizchuta deorayyta yippekun yisrael min galuta.

Yisrael may ka amre. vayyomru lo nuchal ad asher yeasfu kol haadarim, ad deyitkanneshu kol shear yomin illain. vegallu et haeven, veyigganderun lehahu dina kashya dehahu yoma deshalta al pi habbeer, veishtechachat hahi beer begaluta immana. vechad itgalyay hay beer, vehahu even la shalta alah, miyyad vehishkinu hatztzon.

Vezammin kudesha berich hu besof yomayyay, leahadra leyisrael leara kaddisha, uleachnesha lon miggaluta. uman innun sof yomayyay, hahu dehi acharit hayyamim. behay acharit hayyamim, yisrael savlu galuta. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim, uchetiv (Devarim 31:29) vekarat etchem haraa beacharit hayyamim. beacharit hayyamim dayyka, veda hi keneset yisrael begaluta. veim acharit hayyamim da, kabbilu onsha begaluta. uveda yabid kudesha berich hu nukemin leyisrael tedira. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 24:14) asher yaase haam hazze leammecha beacharit hayyamim. uvechol atar da hi, vekudesha berich hu zammin leatava lah leatraha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:2) vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai vegomer veda hu yom.

Umiddeshare tzel lemebad besheruta deyoma ochora, kema bezimna deitchariv makdesha hava, venata tzel lemeal. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki pana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. yom vetzel, hu sof galuta. veshiura dehay tzel, shit kematzin ufalga. uvegudal demishcha devar nash, gevar ben guverin. veducherana dehay raza deven chavrayyay, dichtiv, (Iyov 8:9) ki temol anachnu velo neda ki tzel yamenu ale aretz. ki temol anachnu begaluta, vela havena yade ki tzel yamenu ale aretz, leashraa lon kudesha berich hu ale aretz.

Zakkaa chulakeh man dechame leh, vezakkaa chulakeh man dela chame leh. vavy leman deyizdaman kad yitba arya ravreva, leitchabbera lenukeveh. kol shekken beshaata deyizdavvevgun kachada, al hahi shaata ketiv, (Amos 3:8) arye shaag mi lo yira vegomer.

Ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 25:30) shaog yishag al navehu. uvehahu zimna kad yippuk lekabbela levat zugo, keden arye shaag mi lo yira Adonai elohim dibber mi lo yinnave. behahi shaata ketiv, (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha vegomer. veshav may hu, ella kudesha berich hu shav keneset yisrael miggaluta, veshav tzaddik leizdavvevga beatreh. keden ketiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha.

Matnitin, lechon bene nasha, mare dechachmeta, mare desuchletanu, kala kare. man minnechon deitchakkam veyada, beshaata deresha chivvavra, atkin resha, reshima meella letatta, umittatta leella. atkin setar tzafon, beittura dekunarita, beh rashim umeka dithoma illaa, desalik venachit begavvevy. nachit chad darga temira, beelef vachamesh mea reshimin, deelef vachamesh mea almin.

(Daniel 4:9) techoteh tatlel chad chevat bara, (Daniel 7:7) vekarnayin eser lah. vaaru ayynin keayyne enasha lechevata, ufum memallel ravrevan. kad salleka, azla bimama, temira belelya. kad nachta, temira bimama, veazla belelya. kad natla, mizdazean arba magrofe daachidan bidaha. venatlin immah shittin pulesin denura, kol chad charba shinnana al yerecheh.

Salik biruta, leappaka bar nash shallita letatta. atkin behay chevata chad afra dekika, kalil mikkolla. nashav beh, itpeshat bed sitre alma. ved pulesin itgalgalu, chad leella, chad letatta, chad latztzafon, chad laddarom.

Ilana chad ravreva vetakkif, itchabbar veizdevavg bah bechad anpa shappira, dechezu chedvavta decholla. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 48:3) yefe nof mesos kol haaretz. beh izdevavg, appiku chad rucha temira, umalya lehahu gevilu deafra, vekaim al ragloy, veamlecheh al kol alma, veshalteh al kolla. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 8:7) tamshilehu bemaase yadecha vegomer. itpekid al hahu ilana, la natar pikkuda, ativ malka rucheh legabbeh, vehahu chevata natla leh.
Keden zeminin mana achara, vekaim benayyhu. bekutera diglifin ben malachin kaddishin, betufesra (sefer acher batepasea) deitturin itachadan.

Darin batrain, tefisin bechovayyhu. ishtelif ruchehon mehahu mana dilvusha, levatar agniz beafra, ben rigve nachala ittemaru veitgenizu. bechad garma takkif dehahu mana, yitbenun bekadmita, vikumun chelin chelin tinyaynut, beara kaddisha mitarin.

Vezammin kudesha berich hu, lemigbal hahu afra kadmita, dehahu mana mammash. uleaala beh gevilu dakik kehay chamira deisa. umehahu gevilu deihu tzachuta dilella, yittakkan veyityeshar mana dechashra. kegavvna deamar kera, (Yoel 4:18) umayan mibbet Adonai yetze vehishka et nachal hashittim. begin dehahu nachal asge chavivuta (sefer acher zechuta) (sefer acher zenuta) bealma. vechad hahu mayayna kaddisha, yippuk veyeul legabbeh, keden yittakkan veyityeshar, vela yehe besurechaneh kekadmita.

1551: Pikkuda batar da, lekabbel bet din haggadol alayyhu, bina, missitra digdula ikre elohim, bet din haggadol, rav bedinoy, verav bezachvoy, kegavvna deittemar som tasim alecha melech befikkuda, som leella, tasim letatta. hachi lekabbel aleh bet din ravreva, af al gav dekabbil aleh bet din zeera. bet din zeera, bet din shel shelosha, missitra dishchinta tattaa. bet din ravreva, meillen sanheddere gedola.

Hay attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin, la adkar, vela ishtechach. uvegin deihu resha illaa lechol illain, la idkar, bar resha chada, bela gufa, lekayyeyma kolla.

Vei tema, man attika kaddisha. ta chaze, leella leella, it dela ityeda, vela ishtemoda, vela itreshim, vehu kalil kolla, uteren reshin beh kelilan (sefer acher talyayn). ucheden kolla (chada) hachi ittekan. vehahu lav beminyayna, vela bichlala vela bechusheban ella biruta delibba, al da ittemar, (Tehillim 39:2) amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni.

Atar desheruta ishtechach, meattika kaddisha, deitnehir mimmazzala, hu nehiru dechachmeta, deitpeshat litllatin uteren ivar. venafka mehahu mocha setimaa, minnehiru deveh. uma deattika kaddisha nahir bekadmita (sefer acher bechachmeta), da hi. vesheruta mimma deitgalyay (have), veitavid litlat reshin, veresha chada kalil lon. veillen telat mitpashshetan lizer anpin, umeillen naharin kolla.

Itgelif hay chachmeta, veappik chad nahara, denagid venafik leashkaa ginta veayyil (nusach acher vaayylan) beresha dizer anpin, veitavid chad mocha umittamman itmeshich venagid bechol gufa, veashke kol innun netian. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan vegomer.

Tu itgelif hay chachmeta, veitmeshach veayil beresha dizer anpin, veitavid mocha achara (hahu achara). hahu nehiru deitmashshecha minneh illen teren meshichan itgelifu, mitchabberan bechad resha deamika devera, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:20) bedato tehomot nivkau. veayyil beresha dizer anpin, veitavid mocha achara, umittamman itmeshich veayyil lego gufa, umalyay kol innun iddarin veachsadrin degufa. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:4) uvedaat chadarim yimmalu.
1553: Veillen naharin, minnehiru dehahu mocha illaa setimaa, denahir bemazzala (attika kaddisha). vecholla da beda talyayn. veitkeshar da beda, veda beda, ad deyishtemoda decholla chad, vecholla hu attika, vela itperash minneh kelum. illen telat nehorin, nehirin litlat acharanin, deikrun avahan. veillen naharin livnin. vecholla nahir meatar chad. kad itgalyay hay attika, raavav deraavavn, kolla nahir vecholla ishtechach bechedu shelemata.

Hay chachmeta ikre eden, vehay eden itmeshach meeden illaa, setimaa dechol setimin. umehay eden, ikre sheruta. divattika la ikre, vela have sheruta vesiyyuma. uvegin dela have beh sheruta vesiyyuma, la ikre atta. begin deitkasyay vela itgalyay. veikre hu. umeatar desheruta ishtechach ikre atta, veikre av. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu.

Beaggadta deve rav yeva sava, kelala decholla, zeer anpin ikre atta. attika kaddisha deitkasyay, ikre hu. veshappir. vehasheta karenan baatar da desheruta ishtechach, atta. af al gav deitkasyay, minneh have sheruta, veikre av. vehu av laavahan. vehay av nafik meattika kaddisha, dichtiv (Iyov 28:12) vehachachma meayin timmatze. uvegin kach la ishtemoda.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Iyov 28:23) elohim hevin darkah, darkah mammash. aval vehu yada et mekomah, mekomah mammash. vekol shekken darkah. (mekomah mammash. velo darkah. mekomah mammash. vechol shekken darkah.) vekol shekken hahu chachma distima beh beattika kaddisha.

Hay chachma sheruta decholla, minneh mitpashshetan telatin uteren shevilin. (shevilin velo archin) veorayyta behu itkelilat beesrin uteren atvavn, veeser amiran. hay chachma av laavahan. uvehay chachma, sheruta vesiyyuma ishtechach. uvegin da, chachma illaa chachma tattaa. kad itpeshat chachma, ikre av laavahan. kolla la itkelil ella behay. (sefer acher kad mitpashshetan chachmot, itkere av laavahan. kolla lo itkelil ella behay) dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita.

Zakaf ribbi shimon yedoy, vechade, amar, vadday iddan hu legallaa, vecholla itzterich beshaata da. tana, beshaata deattika kaddisha, setimaa dechol setimin, baa leatkena kolla, atkin keen dechar venukeba. baatar deitkelilu dechar venukeba la itkeyaymu, ella bekiyyuma achara (sefer acher keen dechar) (ella badekar) didchar venukeba. vehay chachma kelala decholla, kad nafka veitnehir meattika kaddisha, la itnehir ella bidchar venukeba. dehay chachma itpeshat, veappik minneh bina, veishtechach dechar venukeba. hu, chachma av. bina em. chachma uvina, bechad matkela ittekalu, dechar venukeba. uveginayyhu kolla itkeyaym bidchar venukeba, deilmale hay, la mitkayyeymin.

Sheruta da av lecholla, av lechullehu avahan, itchabbaru da beda, unehiru da beda. (chachma av. bina im. 0 ki im levenah tikkare) kad itchabbaru, olidu, veitpashtat mehemnuta. beaggadta deve rav yeva sava, hachi tane, mahu bina. ella kad itchabbar da beda, yod beHei, itabberat, veappikat ben, veolidat. uvegin kach, bina ikre, ben yah, shelemuta decholla. ishtechachu tarvavyyhu demitchabberan, uven begavvavyyhu. kelala decholla. betikkunayyhu ishtechach shelemuta (nusach acher ben 15, tarvavyyhu demitchabberan, uven begavvavyyhu. batekavenayyhev ishtechachu shelemuta decholla kelala) decholla, av vaem. ben uvat.

Millin illen, la ityeyhivu legallaa, bar lekaddishe elyonin, dealu venafku, veyadin archoy dekudesha berich hu, dela satan behu limina velismala. dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam vegomer. zakkaa chulakeh, deman dezache leminda orchoy, vela sate, vela yite behu. demillin illen setimin innun vekaddishe elyonin nehirin behu, keman denahir minnehiru devutzina. la itmesaru millin illen, ella leman deal venafik. deman dela al venafak, tav leh dela ivre. deha galya kamme attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin, demillin illen nehirin belibbay, beashlemuta dirchimuta udechilu dekudesha berich hu. veillen benay dehacha, yedana behu deha alu venafku, veitnehiran beillen millin, vela bechullehu. vehasheta itnehiru bishlemuta kema deitzterich. zakkaa chulaki immehon, behahu alma.
1554: Amar ribbi shimon, kol ma daamena deattika kaddisha. vechol ma daamena dizer anpin. kolla chad, kolla hu chad milla. la talyay beh piruda. berich hu berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin.
Ta chaze, sheruta da deikre av, itkelil beYod, detalyay mimmazzala kaddisha. uvegin kach, yod kalil atvavn acharanin. 10 setima dechol atvavn acharan. 10 resha vesefa decholla.

Vehahu nahar denagid venafik, ikre alma deate, deate tadir vela pasik. vehay hu idduna detzaddikayya, lezakkaa lehay alma deate, deashke tadir leginta, vela pasik. aleh ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:11) uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav. vehahu alma deate, ivre beYod, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. 10 kalil teren atvavn 10.

Beaggadta deve rav yeva sava tanenan, amay 10 kelilan beYod. ella netia deginta (sefer acher vadday) da, ikre 6. it ginta achara, deihi 4. umehay 6, ishtakyay 4. (deihi arbaa rashim) vehayeynu raza dichtiv, venahar yotze meeden vegomer. may eden. da chachma illaa, veda 10. lehashekot. et haggan, da hu 6. umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim, da hu 4, vecholla kalil beYod.

Uvegin kach, ikre av lecholla. av laavahan. sheruta decholla, (ikre) beta decholla, dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yibbane bayit. (mehay 10 sheruta vesiyyuma decholla) uchetiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita. beatreh, la itgalyay, vela ityeda. middeitchabbar beimma itremiz beimma uvegin kach imma kelala decholla, bah ityeda uvah itremiz, shiruta vesiyyuma decholla. (chachma ikre) devah satim kolla.

Kelala decholla, shema kaddisha. ad hasheta ramizna, vela amena kol illen yomin. vehaiddana mitgallefin sitrin, 10, kalil behay chachma. Adonai da imma, vekarenan bina. 11, illen teren benin, demitatteran meimma. veha tanenan, devina itkelil mikkolla. yod demitchabbera beimma, umappekin ben. vehayeynu bina, av vaem deinnun 15, ben begavvavyyhu.

Hasheta it leistakkela, bina, veikre tevuna, amay ikre tevuna, vela bina. ella tevuna ikre, beshaata deyanka litren benin, ben uvat, deinnun 11, vehahi shaata ikre tevuna. decholla kalil beilen atvavn, ben uvat, innun 11. vecholla chad kelala, vehayeynu tevuna.

Besifra derav hamenuna sava amar, dishlomo malka, tikkuna kadmaa degalle veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:15) hinnach yafa rayati mehay hu. vetikkuna tinyayna, ikre kalla, deihi nukeba diltatta. veinnun deamre, detarvavyyhu lehay nukeba diltatta innun, lav hachi. dehe kadmaa la ikre kalla. vehe batraa, ikre kalla, lezimnin (yedian) yediin (lezimnin saggiin). deha zimnin saggiin innun, didchura la itchabbar immah, veistallak minnah. behahu zimna ketiv, (Vayikra 18:19) veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav. beshaata deitdakkeat nukeba, udechura bae leitchabbera immah, keden ikre kalla. kechalla mammash atyay.

(Aval) hay imma, la afsik reuta detarvavyyhu lealmin, bechad nafkin, bechad sharyayn. la afsik da min da, vela istellak da min da. uvegin kach ketiv venahar yotze meeden, yotze tadir, vela afsik. hada hu dichtiv, uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav. uvegin kach ketiv rayati, biruta deachva sharyayn, beachaduta shelemuta (shelemata). aval hacha ikre kalla, dechad ata dechura leitchabbera immah, hi kalla, kechalla ihi atyay mammash.

Uvegin kach, tere (vaychi 242) tikkunin denukeve parish shelomo. tikkuna dekadmeta setima, begin deihi setima. vetikkuna tinyayna parish yattir, vela satim kule hay. ulevatar talya kol shevacha behahi dilella. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi leimmah bara hi leyoladtah. uvegin deihi imma mitattera beitra dechalla, ureuta deyod la afsik minnah lealmin, ityehiv birshutah kol cheru deavdin. kol cheru decholla. kol cheru dechayayvayya, ledakkaa lecholla. dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:30) ki vayom hazze yechapper alechem. uchetiv (Vayikra 25:10) vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana yovel hi. may yovel. kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 17:8) veal yuval yeshallach sharashav. mishshum hahu nahar deate venagid venafik, veate tadir, vela pasik.
1555: Ketiv (Mishlei 2:3) ki im labbina tikra lattevuna titten kolecha. kevan deamar ki im labbina tikra, amay lattevuna. ella kolla kema daamena. he minnayyhu illaa. bina illaa mittevuna. bina av vaem uven. 15: av vaem, uven begavvavyyhu. tevuna: kolla kelala divnin, ben uvat, 11. vela ishtechach av vaem, ella boimma doimma vadday (sefer acher babbina. uvitvuna vadday ema) revia alayyhu, vela itgalyay. ishtechach dichlala ditren benin, ikre tevuna. uchelala deav em uven, ikre bina. vechad bae leachlela kolla, behay itkelil.

Vehay av vaem uven, ikrun chachma bina vadaat. begin dehay ben natil simanin daavoy veimmeh, ikre daat, dehu sahaduta detarvavyyhu. vehay ben, ikre buchera. dichtiv, (Shemot 4:22) beni vechori yisrael. uvegin deikre buchera, natil teren chulakin. vechad itrabbe beitroy, natil telat chulakin. uven kach uven kach, teren chulakin, utelat chulakin kolla chad milla. vehay vehay hachi (sefer acher chad) have, yeruta deavoy veimmeh yarit.

May yeruta da. achasanta daavoy veimmeh, uteren itrin dahavo genizin begavvavyyhu, veachasinu leven da. missitra daavoy, hava ganiz begavevy chad itra, deikre chesed. umissitra deimma, chad itra deikre gevura. vechullehu mitatterin beresheh, veachid lon. vechad naharin illen av vaem aleh, kullehu ikrun tefillin deresha. vecholla natil ben da, veyarit kolla, veitpeshshat bechol gufa. vehay ben yahiv livratta. uveratta minneh ittezan. veal kol panim mikkan, bera yarit vela beratta. bera yarit laavuy uleimmeh vela beratta. uminneh ittezan beratta. kema dichtiv, (Daniel 4:9) umazon lecholla veh. (vei tema kol hay vehay ikrun tzaddik vatzedek bechad inun vechad kolla).

Hane av vaem, kelilan umitchabberan da beda. veav tamir yattir. vecholla achid meattika kaddisha, vetalya mimmazzala kaddisha, yakiru (yakkira) dechol yakirin. veillen av vaem, metakkenin beta, kema daamena dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:3-4) bechachma yibbane bayit uvitvuna yitkonan uvedaat chadarim yimmalu kol hon yakar venaim. uchetiv (Mishlei 22:18) ki naim ki tishmerem bevitnecha. (hane kelala decholla, kema daamena vetalyayn mamezalea kaddisha yakkira).

Amar ribbi shimon, beiddara la galena kolla. vechol hane millin, temirin belibbay havo ad hasheta, uvaena leatmera lon lealma deate, mishshum detamman sheelta shail lana, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:6) vehaya emunat ittecha chosen yeshuot chachma vadaat vegomer, vechachma bayayn mini, vehasheta reuta dekudesha berich hu behay, ha bela kissufa iul kamme palteroy.

Ketiv (Shmuel 1 2) ki el deot Adonai. deot vadday. hu haddaat. bedaat kol palteroy itmalleyayn. dichtiv, uvedaat chadarim yimmalu. (begin kach) daat achara la itgalya, deha temira azil begavevy, veitkelil beh. daat nahir bemochin, veitpeshat bemocha kolla. (bemocha, begufa kolla, ki el deot Adonai)

Besifra deaggadta tanenan, ki el deot Adonai, al tikre deot, ella edut. dehu sahaduta decholla, sahaduta ditren chulakin, kema deat amer (Tehillim 78:5) vayyakem edut beyaakov. veaf al gav dehay milla, okmuha besifra ditzniuta begavvna achara. hatam beatreh shelim, hacha kolla shappir, vecholla have, kad astim milla.

Hay av vaem, kullehu behu kelilan, kolla behu setiman, veinnun setiman bemazzala kaddisha, attika dechol attikin. beh setiman. beh kelilan. kolla hu, kolla have. berich hu, berich shemeh, lealam ulealme almin.

Kol millin deiddara yaut, vechullehu millin kaddishin, millin dela satan limina velismala, kullehu millin distimin, veitgalyayn leinnun dealu venafku, vecholla hachi hu. vead hasheta havo mitkasyayn illen millin dedachilna legallaa, vehasheta itgalyayn. vegalle kamme (malka) attika kaddisha, deha la likara dili udevet abba avidna, ella begin dela iul bechissufa kame palteroy avidna. veod, ha chamena, dekudesha berich hu vechol hane zakkae keshot dehacha mishtakkechan, kullehu mistakkemin al yeday. deha chamena dechullehu chaddan behay hilula dili, vechullehu zeminin behahu alma behillula dili, zakkaa chulaki.
1556: Amar ribbi abba, kad siyyem milla da butzina kaddisha, butzina illaa, arim yedoy, uvacha vechayich. baa legallaa milla chada. amar, bemilla da itztaarna kol yomay, vehasheta la yahavin li reshuta. ittakkaf, veyativ, verachish besifvavteh, vesagid telat zimnin, vela hava yachil bar nash leistakkela baatreh, kol shekken beh. amar, puma puma, dezachit lechol hay, la angivu mabbuach. mabbuach nafik vela pasak. alach karenan (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 58:11) uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav.

Haiddana ashadna alay. dechol yomin dekaemna, taivna lemecheme yoma da, (nusach acher reuta legallaa raza da) vela salik biruti (sefer acher bide), bar haiddana, deha beitra da mitattar hay yoma. vehasheta baena legallaa millin, kammeh dekudesha berich hu, deha kullehu mitatterin bereshe (beresheh). vehay yoma la yitrachak lemeal leducheteh, keyoma achara. deha kol yoma da birshuti kayyeyma. vehasheta sharena legallaa millin, begin dela iul bechissufa lealma deate. veha sharena ema.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha chesed veemet yekaddemu panecha. man chakkima, yistakkal behay, lemecheme orchoy (sefer acher dinoy) dekaddisha illaa, dinin dikshot, dinin demitatterin bechitri illain. deha chamena dechullehu butzinin naharin mibbutzina illaa, temira dechol temirin, kullehu dargin leitnahara. (nusach acher vechullehu inun dargin leitnahara) uvehahu nehora divchol darga vedarga, itgalyay ma deitgalyay, vechullehu nehorin achidan, nehora da binhora da, unehora da, binhora da, venaharin da beda, vela mitparshan da min da.

Nehora dechol butzina uvutzina, deikrun tikkune malka, kitre malka, kol chad vechad, nahir veachid behahu nehora dilgo lego, vela mitperash levar. uvegin kach kolla bechad darga istellak, vecholla bechad milla itattar, vela mitperash da min da, ihu ushemeh chad hu. nehora deitgalyay, ikre levusha demalka. nehora dilgo lego, (behahu nehora hu 45) nehora satim, uveh sharya hahu dela itperash vela itgalyay.

Vechullehu butzine, vechullehu nehorin, naharin meattika kaddisha setima dechol setimin, butzina illaa. vechad mistakkelan, kullehu nehorin deitpashshetan. la ishtechach bar butzina illaa, deatmar vela itgalyay.

Beinnun levushin dikar, levushe keshot, tikkune keshot, butzine keshot, ishtechachu teren butzinin, tikkuna dechuresyay demalka, veikrun tzedek umishpat. veinnun sheruta, ushelemuta, bechol mehemnuta. uvehane mitatterin kol dinin dilella vetatta, vecholla satim bemmishpat. vetzedek mehay mishpat ittezan. ulezimnin karenan lah, (Bereshit 14:17-18) umalki tzedek melech shalem.

Kad mitarin dinin mimmishpat, kullehu rachame, kullehu bishlimu. dehay mevassem lehay tzedek, vedinin mittakkenin, vechullehu nachtin lealma bishlimu, berachame. ucheden (ikre) shaata demitchabberan dechar venukeba, vechol almin kullehu berachame, uvechedvavta.

Vechad asgiu chove alma, veistaavat makdesha, udechura itrechak min nukeba, vechivya takkifa sharya leatteara, vavy lealma demittezan behahu zimna mehay tzedek. kama chavile terikin mitarin bealma, kama zakkain mistallekin mealma. vechol kach lamma. begin deitrechak dechura min nukeba, umishpat la karev betzedek da. veal hay ketiv, (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat, demishpat itrechak mehay tzedek, vela itbasma, vetzedek yanka meatar ochora.

Veal da amar shelomo malka, (Kohelet 7:15) et hakkol raiti bime hevli yesh tzaddik oved betzidko vegomer, havel da, (sefer acher 33 hevel da) havel chada, mehavalim dilella, deikrun appe malka, veda ihu malchuta kaddisha, dechad hi mittara bedinoy, ketiv yesh tzaddik oved betzidko. may tama. mishshum demishpat itrechak mitzedek. uvegin kach ikre, veyesh nispe belo mishpat.
1557: Ta chaze, kad ishtechach zakkaa illaa bealma, rechima dekudesha berich hu, afillu kad ittear tzedek bilchodoy, yachil alma leishtezava begineh. vekudesha berich hu bae bikareh, vela mistafe min dina. vechad hahu zakkaa la kayyeyma bekiyyumeh, mistafe afillu mimmishpat, vela yachil lemekam beh. kol shekken betzedek.

David malka, bekadmita amar, (tehillim 26) bechaneni Adonai venasseni. deha ana la mistafena mikkol dinin, afillu mehay tzedek, vekol shekken daachidna beh, ma ketiv. (Tehillim 17:15) ani betzedek echeze fanecha, betzedek vadday. la mistafena lemekam bedinoy. batar dechav, afillu mimmishpat mistafe, dichtiv, (Tehillim 143:2) veal tavo vemishpat et avdecha. ta chaze, kad mitbassema hay tzedek mimmishpat, keden ikre tzedaka. vealma mitbassema bechesed, veitmalleya minneh. dichtiv, (Tehillim 33:5) ohev tzedaka umishpat chesed Adonai mala haaretz.

Ashadna alay, dechol yomai havena mitztaer al alma, dela yeera bedinoy detzedek, vela yokid alma beshalhovoy. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:20) achla umachata fiha. mikkan ulehala, kefum kol chad, kefum bera imka, veha bedara da it beh zakkain, uzeirin innun dikumun leaggana al alma, veal ana, mearbaa zivyan. (sefer acher al alma, vaalaynaa bayayn).

Al ken achidan millay da beda, umitparshan millin distimin beattika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin, vehech achidan illen beillen. mikkan lehala, millin dizer anpin, innun dela itgalleyayn beiddara. innun dahavo setimin belibbay, vetamman la ittekanu. (74 kan sateymen millin) hasheta ittekanu veitgalyayn, vechullehu millin setimin, uveririn kullehu. zakkaa chulaki, veinnun deyartu yeruta da, dichtiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo vegomer.

Hay deokimna, av vaem beattika achidan, betikkunoy, hachi hu. deha mimmocha setimaa dechol setimin talyayn, (nusach acher nafkin) umitachadan beh. (veaf al gav deattika kaddisha ittakkan bilchodoy) vechad yistakkelun (bechol) millay. kolla hu attika bilchodoy, hu have, vehu yehe. vechol hane tikkunin beh. (72 lo nimtza achidan beh sateymen lo mitparshan minneh mocha setimaa lo itgalyay velo talya beh) av vaem mehay mocha nafku, itkelilu bemazzala, uveh talyayn, uveh achidan. zeer anpin, beattika kaddisha talyay veachid. veha okimna mille beiddara. zakkaa chulakeh deman deal venafik, veyinda orchin dela yiste limina velismala. uman dela al venafak, tav leh dela ivre. uchetiv (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai.

Amar ribbi shimon, mistakkel havena kol yoma behay kera, dichtiv, (Tehillim 34:3) baAdonai tithallel nafshi yishmeu anavim veyismachu. vehaiddana itkeyaym kera kolla. baAdonai tithallel nafshi vadday, deha nishmati beh achida, beh lahata, beh itdabbekat veishtaddelat uveishtaddeluta da tistallak leatraha. yishmeu anavim veyismachu, kol hane tzaddikayyay, vechol bene metivta kaddisha, vezakkain deatyayn hasheta im kudesha berich hu, kullehu shamin millay, vechaddan. begin kach, (Tehillim 34:4) gaddelu laAdonai itti uneromma shemo yachdav.

Patach veamar, ketiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 48:5) ki hinne hammelachim noadu avru yachdav. noadu, bean atar. beeretz edom. baatar dedinin mitachadin tamman. avru yachdav, dichtiv vayyamat vayyimloch tachtav. hemma rau ken tamahu nivhalu nechpazu, dela itkeyaymu beatrayyhu, begin detikunin demalka la ittekanu, vekarta kaddisha veshuroy, la izdemanu.

Hada hu dichtiv, kaasher shamanu ken rainu vegomer, deha kullehu la itkeyaymu, vehi itkayyeymat hasheta, besitra didchura, desharya immah. hada hu dichtiv, vayyimloch tachtav hadar veshem iro pau veshem ishto mehetavel bat matred bat me zahav. me zahav vadday kema deokimna beidara.
1558: Veha besifra deaggadta derav hamenuna sava ittemar, vayyimloch tachtav hadar. hadar vadday, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 23:40) peri etz hadar. veshem ishto mehetavel, kema deat amer kappot temarim. uchetiv, (Tehillim 92:13) tzaddik kattamar yifrach, deihi dechar venukeba. hay itkeriat bat matred, bat mehahu atar detardin kolla leitdabbeka, veikre av. uchetiv (Iyov 28:13) lo yada enosh erkah velo timmatze beeretz hachayyim. davar acher, bat meimma, demissitraha mitachadin dinin, detardin lecholla. bat me zahav, deyanka bitren anpin, dinhiru bitren gavvnin. bechesed uvedina.

Ad la ivre alma, la havo mashgichin anpin beanpin, uvegin kach, almin kadmae itcharavu, vealmin kadmae bela tikkuna itavidu. vehahu dela hava betikkuna, ikre zikin nitzotzin, kehay umana, martzefa (sefer acher marezapetaa), kad achtish bemana (Bereshit 156 amud alef) defarzela, appik zikin lechol ivar, veinnun zikin denafkin, nafkin lehitin unehirin, vedaachin lealtar. veillen ikrun almin kadmae. uvegin kach itcharavu vela itkeyaymu. ad deittakan attika kaddisha, venafik umana (davar acher mana) leumanuteh.

Veal hay tanena bematnita dilan, (daneytzevatzea) devutzina appik zikin (Shemot 254 amud bet, Bereshit 107 amud bet sitre tora) bazikin (nusach acher devutzina appik zikin nitzotzin) litlat mea veesrin ivar. veinnun zikin, almin kadmae ikrun, umitu lealtar. levatar nafik umana (sefer acher mana) leumanuteh, veittekkan bidchar venukeba, vehane zikin deitdaachu umitu, hasheta itkeyaym kolla. mibbutzina dekardinuta, nafak nitzotza, patisha takkifa, devatash, veappik zikin almin kadmae, umitarve (davar acher vametadekay) baavira dachya, veitbesamu da beda.

Kad itchabbar abba veimma, vehahu av hu, merucha deganiz beattik yomin, beh itgeniz hay avera, veachlil lenitzotza, denafik mibbutzina dekardinuta deganiz bemeoy deimma. vechad itchabbaru tarvavyyhu, veitkelilu da beda. nafik gulegalta chad takkifa, veitfashshat besitroy, da besitra da, veda besitra da. kema deattika kaddisha telat reshin ishtechachu bechad, kach kolla izdeman bitlat reshin, kema (288 amud bet) daamena.

Behay gulegalta dizer anpin, natif talla meresha chivvavra (veachid leh), vehahu talla itchaze bitre gevavne. uminneh mittezan chakla detappuchin kaddishin. umehay talla degulegalta da, tachanin mana letzaddikayyay lealma deate, uveh zeminin metayyay laachayyay. vela izdeman mana denafal mehay talla, bar hahu zimna bezimna deazlu yisrael bemadbera, vezan lehu attika decholla, mehay atar. ma dela ishtechach levatar. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. kema deat amer (Bereshit 27:28) veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim vegomer. hay behahu zimna. lezimna achara tanenan, kashim mezonotav shel adam kamme kudesha berich hu. veha bemazzala talyay bemazzala vadday. veal ken bene chayye umezone, lav bizchuta talyay milleta, ella bemazzala talyay milleta, vecholla talyayn behay mazzala, kema deokimna.

Tisha alfin ribbo almin, natlin vesamchin al hay gulegalta. vehay avira dachya itkelil becholla, kevan dehu kalil mikkolla vecholla itkelil beh, itpeshatu anpoy litren sitrin, bitre nehorin kelilan mikkolla. vechad istakkalu anpoy, beanpin deattika kaddisha, kolla erech appayim ikre. may erech appayim. (arich appayim mibbae leh) ella hachi tanenan, begin dearich appeh lechayayvaya. aval erech appayim, asvavta deanpin. deha la ishtechach asvavta bealma, ella bezimna deashgechin anpin beanpin.

Bachalala degulegalta, nehirin telat nehorin. vei tema telat, arba innun, kema daamena, achasanteh daavoy veimmeh, uteren genizin dilhon, demitatteran kullehu beresheh, veinnun tefillin deresha. levatar mitchabberan besitroy, venaharin vealin bitlat chalale degulegalta. nafkin kol chad besitroy, umitpashshetin bechol gufa.
1559: Veillen mitchabberin bitre moche. umocha telitaa kalil lon, veachid (veinnun tefillin deresha. veillen mitchabberin bitre mochi. umocha telitaa kalil lon, venaharin vealin bitlat challe dagevalegaletaa. levatar nafkin kol chad besitroy, umitpashshetin bechol gufa. vehay mocha telitaa achid) behay sitra uvehay sitra, umitpashshat bechol gufa, veitavid minneh tere gevavne kelilan kachada. umehay nahir anpoy, veashid beabba veimma gevavne deanpoy. vehu ikre daat, bedaat (sefer acher beda) ketiv, (Shmuel 1 2:3) ki el deot Adonai vegomer, begin deihu bitre gevavne lo nitkenu alilot. aval leattika kaddisha setimaa, la nitkenu. may tama nitkenu lehay. begin deyarit teren chuleke, uchetiv (Shmuel 2 22:26) im chasid titchassad vegomer.

Veha bikshot okimu chavrayay, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyagged yaakov lerachel ki achi aviha hu. vayyagged, ha okmuha, decholla raza dechachmeta. vechi ben rivka hu. ben rivka, vela ketiv ben yitzchak. remez, vecholla remiza bechachmeta.
Veal hay ikre shelim becholla. uveh itchaze mehemnuta. uvegin kach ketiv, vayyagged yaakov, vela ketiv vayyomer.

Hane gevavne, kema denaharin beitra deresha, vealin bachalale degulegalta. hachi mitpashshetin bechol gufa, vegufa itachid behu. (aval) leattika kaddisha setima, la nitkenu, vela yayan leh, deha kolla bechad ishtechach, chedu lecholla, chayyim lecholla. la talyay beh dina. aval behay, lo nitkenu alilot vadday.

Begulegalta deresha, talyayn kol innun ribbevavn vealfin (kotze) mikotze desarin, deinnun uchamin. umistabbechin da beda, achidan da beda, daachidan binhiru illaa dimater (dametaatar) beresheh meabba, umimmocha deitnehir meabba. levatar nafkin nimin al nimin, minnehiru demitattar beresheh meimma, umishar moche. vechullehu achidan, umistabbeche beinnun sare daachidan meabba, begin deinnun mitarvin da beda, umistabbechin da beda.

Vechullehu moche achidan beguleguleta, bemocha illaa. vechullehu meshichan (daatameshaken) itmashshechan mittelat chalale democha, (achidan bamevachey) mitarvan da beda, bedachya bimsaava. bechol innun taamin verazin, setimin umitgalyayn. uvegin kach kullehu moche remize (kach nimtza 72) beanochi Adonai elohecha vechulei, kema dinhorin beitra deresha, vealin bachalale degulegalta.

Kol innun kotzin uchamin, chafyayn vetalyayn lesitra deudenin. veha okimna, debgin kach ketiv, (Melachim 2 19:16) hatte Adonai aznecha ushama. mikkan okimna, man devae deyarkin malka udeneh lokovleh, yesalsel beresheh demalka, veyifne sare meal udenoy, veyyishma leh malka bechol ma devae.

Befalguta desare, mitachada chad orcha, bearcha deattik yomin, umitparshan minneh kol orchoy defikkude orayyta, (vaatamenan alayyhu) kol marehon divava vilala talyayn bechol kotza vekotza, veinnun mafrishin rishta lechayayvaya, dela yadin innun archin. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:19) derech reshaim kaafela. vechol illen talyayn bekotzin takkifin, uvegin kach kullehu takkifin. veokimna beinnun sheian itachadan marehon dematkela, (sefer acher dirchimuta) dichtiv, (Tehillim 25:10) kol archot Adonai chesed veemet. vechol kach, begin demashchin mimmochin setimin dirhite democha.
Uvegin kach mishtachche kol chad kefum orchoy, mechad mocha beinnun kotzin sheian, itmashshechan marehon dematkela, (dirchimuta) dichtiv kol archot Adonai chesed veemet.

Mimmocha tinyayna, beinnun kotzin takkifin, itmashshechan vetalyayn marehon divava vilala dichtiv behu derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu. may ka mayyre. ella lo yadu, kelomar la yadin, vela baan leminda, bamme yikkashelu. al tikre bamme, ella beimma yikkashelu. beinnun demitachadin bistar deimma. may sitra deimma. gevura takkifa minne mitachadan marehon divava vilala.

Mimmocha telitaa, beinnun kotzin deinnun beemtzaita, itmashshechan vetalyayn marehon demidin (dameareyn). veikrun appin nehirin vela nehirin. uvehane ketiv (Mishlei 4:26) palles magal raglecha. vecholla ishtechach beinnun kotzin desare deresha.
